overview: Dragon Block Noea (mod id noeabosses, jar version 1.2.0-dmz221-dev.9-incomplete, by ButterJaffa and contributors, All Rights Reserved) is a very large add-on for Dragon Mine Z 2.2.1 on Forge 1.20.1 that bolts a space-faring late game onto DMZ. It adds a flyable Deep Space dimension with a hand-placed solar system and endless procedural planets you can liberate, conquer or blow up, plus a hidden Treasure Planet, Super Dragon Balls and Super Shenron, Beerus' Planet, a Hell below Other World and the Tournament of Power. On the character side it adds three races (Sphinxian, plus the secret Alien and Demon/Glind), many new form lines (Super Saiyan God/Blue/Rosé, Beast, the Gamma Protocol, Cell Max, Orange Piccolo, Majin Mimicry, player-designed forms), a rebuilt fusion system (Dance, Potara, Fusion Arm Band, master and mob fusion, five-way Ultra fusion), Majin absorption and a God of Destruction career. It also layers new combat on top of DMZ (Flow State, Super Dash, Step Vanish, grabs, Sonic Break, Universe Sense), four-boss instanced raids, sparring against about 100 story fighters, companions and an optional Realistic Mode, and it patches many DMZ configs and behaviours (skills, form prices, TP, wishes, masters) through mixins and one-time config migrations.

features.name: Deep Space travel
features.summary: Noea adds a flyable Deep Space dimension (dmzsuper:space) above Earth. It holds a hand-placed home solar system (Earth, its Moon, the Sun, eight named planets, their moons and Namek) plus endless procedurally generated planets, moons, gas giants, ringed planets, stars, asteroids, black holes and rare alien stations. Most solid bodies can be landed on.
features.howToUse: 1) Finish Dragon Mine Z's Frieza Saga (the check is DMZ saga quest frieza_saga #16). 2) In the Overworld, fly above Y=500 (with or without a Space Pod); a short atmosphere-crossing scene plays and you arrive in Deep Space beside Earth. You can also pick the new 'Deep Space' entry in DMZ's Space Pod destination menu. 3) Fly to within 56 blocks of a planet's or moon's surface and press J (Travel to Nearby Planet) to descend. 4) To leave a planet, fly above Y=300 (falling below Y=-50 also returns you). To go home, approach Earth in space and press J; you land back near the spot you left from.
details: Before the Frieza Saga is done, Earth's atmosphere blocks you and Earth/Moon are shown as locked in the Galaxy Atlas.
While crossing an atmosphere you are made temporarily invulnerable and weightless; if something goes wrong the crossing is cancelled and you are put back safely (press J again to retry).
Short re-entry cooldowns stop bouncing: about 3 s after landing on a generated world, 4 s after returning to space and 5 s after leaving or landing on Earth/Namek.
Landing on Planet Namek takes you into Dragon Mine Z's own Namek dimension at its spawn. Namek and Earth are protected story worlds: they can't be claimed or destroyed.

All generated worlds share one 'planet_surface' dimension; each world gets its own region placed 2,048-block steps apart, generated in the background (about 4 chunks per tick, 8 ms budget by default).
Planet surfaces wrap like a globe: a planet is 1,024 blocks across and a moon 512, and walking or flying past the edge brings you back in on the opposite side.

Space is divided into 256-block sectors; new worlds are grouped into solar systems around nearby stars with at least 700 blocks between planet families (config space.planetFamilyClearance). The home system is a protected zone of radius ~3,450 blocks around x=-175, z=700.
Ki attacks fired in space can hit planets (see Celestial destruction) and shatter asteroids, which drop ore-type items.
Weather on planet surfaces is held clear; Noea's own climate effects replace it.
Server owners can switch the whole system off with [v095.deepSpace] enabled=false in noeabosses-v095.toml.

features.name: Galaxy Atlas and pod autopilot
features.summary: A star-map screen that lists every body within 12,000 blocks, lets you inspect it and can fly your Space Pod there automatically.
features.howToUse: Press M (Galaxy Atlas) in the Overworld, Deep Space, on a generated planet or on Namek. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom, search by name or type ('gas', 'star'…) and toggle 'Landable only'. Select a world, then 'Engage pod autopilot' while riding a Space Pod. Press P to toggle the cinematic 'Pro Cam' during autopilot. Owners can rename their planet here.
details: Shows up to 512 contacts. Gas giants and stars are 'observation only'; black holes are marked as gravitational hazards.
Autopilot needs you to be in a Space Pod, the target must be landable, unlocked and within 12,000 blocks. Starting from a planet surface it lifts off first.
The route planner steers around bodies, giving black holes at least ~500 blocks and stars an extra ~340 blocks of clearance. The pod accelerates up to about 5 blocks per tick.
Autopilot refuses to start during fusion, Flow State/Fly Clash commitments or sparring matches; the server can disable it (features.podAutopilot).
Unnamed generated worlds get names like 'Aster 1A2B'; stars are prefixed 'Star', black holes 'Rift'.
Planet renaming: only the current owner, 1-48 characters, no formatting codes; the new name is shown to every player.

features.name: Procedural planets, moons and stars
features.summary: Every generated body has a kind, a tier and a surface style. Tier sets how strong its defenders are and how hard it is to destroy.
features.howToUse: Fly around Deep Space; bodies appear as you explore. Their nameplate shows tier and destruction 'integrity' (e.g. 'Tier 4 Planet - BP 200T').
details: Kinds and tier ranges: terrestrial planet tier 2-6, moon tier 1-4, ringed planet tier 4-8, gas giant tier 5-8, star tier 9-12. About 4 in 10 sector bodies roll as moons, 3 in 10 terrestrial, 2 in 10 ringed and 1 in 10 gas giants (before spacing rules).
Visual sizes: moons radius 16, terrestrial 68, ringed 78, gas giants 105, stars about 132-200 depending on class. Labels: tier ≤3 'Small Planet', tier ≥6 'Big Planet'.
Generated moons orbit their planet: gas giants get 3, ringed planets 2, terrestrial planets 0 or 1.
Ordinary surface palettes depend on distance from the system's star (a temperature is computed): Verdant, Crimson, Glacial, Astral, Warped and Dune; moons are Lunar.
Rare worlds (beyond 4,500 blocks from home, 12% chance): stained-glass planets (very cold) and toxic planets (temperate).

Exotic themed worlds (beyond 4,500 blocks, 18% chance): Slime planet, Honey hive world, Cherry blossom sanctuary, Metallic assimilation world, Luminous mushroom world, Coral archipelago, Storm crystal world, Volcanic caldera world and Ancient Ender ruins. Hot systems favour metal/caldera, temperate ones slime/honey/cherry/mushroom/coral, others storm crystal/Ender ruins.
Varied moons: new moons may be ice-shell ocean, sulfur, obsidian, crystal or iron-dust moons (Earth's Moon stays normal).
Star classes: Star, White Dwarf, Blue Giant, Red Giant, Orange Hypergiant.
Surface biomes on ordinary worlds include meadow, forest, dunes, badlands, tundra, glacier, fungal and volcanic. Mars is always Crimson, Mercury Volcanic and Venus Dune.

Custom planets: server owners can add up to 32 hand-made planets as JSON files in config/noeabosses/v095/custom/planets (name, coordinates outside the home reserve, tier, palette, body kind, power multiplier), then run /noea v095 validate.

features.name: Planet missions and planet ownership
features.summary: Each generated world has a population (faction). You can start a mission to liberate or conquer it; finishing makes you the planet's owner and pays training points and alignment. Missions are co-operative.
features.howToUse: Land on a generated world. The mission panel shows its faction, kill progress and owner. Choose Start (liberate) or Conquer. Defeat the required number of local enemies (3 + planet tier), then beat the final enemy that appears. Rewards are paid automatically; anyone helping within 128 blocks shares progress and rewards. The objective HUD can be hidden per planet.
details: Factions: Saibaman Colony, Frieza Force Occupation, Peaceful Alien Settlement, Abandoned Colony and Earth's Z-Fighters (Earth only). Honey and cherry worlds are always peaceful, metallic worlds always Frieza-occupied, the Treasure Planet is an abandoned colony; gas giants count as abandoned and moons are either Saibaman or abandoned.
Populations at landing: 7 + 2×tier enemies on a planet, 3 + tier on a moon, none on abandoned colonies.
Enemy battle power per tier: 120,000 × 2.4^(tier-1), randomly 72%-140% of that; final bosses get ×2.15. HP scales with BP (100 × (BP/1000)^0.55, capped at 250 million) and melee is about 4% of HP.

Liberating (Start) a Saibaman or Frieza world gives 'Hero' credit and good alignment; Conquer gives 'Conquest' credit and evil alignment. Peaceful settlements can only be conquered. Claiming an abandoned colony is instant and counts as conquest.
Reward: 24,000 × 2.15^(tier-1) training points (max 600 million), multiplied by planetRewardMultiplier/moonRewardMultiplier and space.missionRewardMultiplier; alignment change of 5 + 3×tier (max 30).
Each finished mission also gives each participant a one-time 0.25% chance (25 in 10,000) of a Treasure Locator.

Owned planets show the owner's name in space. Another player can Conquer an owned world: a guardian with the owner's battle power (recorded when they claimed it) spawns, and beating it transfers ownership.
Earth and Namek can't be claimed. Mission completion can also count toward the God of Destruction 'planetary judgment' trials (see the Destroyer feature, covered elsewhere).

features.name: Planet climate, gravity, wildlife and aliens
features.summary: Generated worlds have their own weather cycles, moon gravity, recoloured animals and alien villagers.
features.howToUse: Automatic once you land. Server switches are in noeabosses-v1.toml (features.planetClimateEffects, features.moonGravity, features.planetWildlife, features.alienSettlements).
details: Gravity: every moon uses low gravity, 0.35× on Earth's Moon and 0.4× on generated moons (fall damage scales the same way). Planets, Namek and Beerus' planet use normal gravity. Noea does this through Forge's entity-gravity attribute only.

Weather runs in 6-minute cycles. Depending on the local biome you get heat waves (drain about 0.1% of max stamina per second at full strength), cold fronts (Slowness above 80% strength), strong winds or dust storms (push you sideways). Shelter under a roof avoids it; moons have none.
Toxic worlds: swimming in their green water briefly poisons you (4 s).
Storm crystal worlds call down lightning near visitors about every 32 seconds.

Wildlife: about 65% of ordinary worlds have life; cows, pigs and chickens get alien-shaped bodies, colour names (Azure, Ember, Jade, Violet, Amber, Rose) and herds; fish appear in deep water and striders in volcanic lava. Caps: 32 per world, 16 near you.

Exotic worlds spawn themed creatures (slimes, bees, mushroom creatures, magma cubes, endermen, aquatic life); metallic worlds spawn hostile Metal Cooler copies. Hostile ones need non-Peaceful difficulty; cap 12 nearby.

Alien Inhabitants: peaceful worlds (and one in four Frieza-occupied ones) grow small settlements of 3 procedurally designed aliens (named species such as 'Varani' or 'Khethian', horns/antennae/crests, DMZ gi outfits). They only fight back when attacked, can fly to fight, and their power is about 22% of a normal defender.
Beds work on generated worlds: sleeping sets your respawn there, and DMZ revival from Enma also returns you to that planet bed.

features.name: Destroying moons, planets and stars
features.summary: Heavy ki attacks fired in Deep Space can blow up celestial bodies if their 'planet-busting power' beats the body's integrity. Destruction pays training points but costs alignment.
features.howToUse: In Deep Space, hit a body with an overcharged (110%+) Wave, Beam, Giant Ball or Explosion technique, or a Medium Ball of size 1.75+. Moons don't need overcharge. An authorised Hakai from a God of Destruction always works. Anyone on the surface gets a warning and should fly above Y=300 before it detonates.
details: Planet-busting power = your battle power × technique factor × charge² (at least 1) × size factor (1-4). Technique factors: Giant Ball 50,000, Explosion 35,000, Wave 30,000, Beam 25,000, Medium Ball 18,000; Death Ball, Supernova and Spirit Bomb count as at least 50,000 and Final Flash at least 35,000.

Integrity needed (before the server's requiredPowerMultiplier): moons 600M / 850M / 1.2B / 1.7B (tier 1/2/3/4+); terrestrial planets 50T / 80T / 130T / 200T / 300T (tier 2-6); ringed planets 400T-900T (tier 4-8); gas giants 1.1-2.4 Qa (tier 5-8); stars 3 Qa / 5 Qa / 9 Qa / 18 Qa (tier 9-12).
Example: a tier-2 terrestrial planet (50T) needs roughly 830K battle power with a Giant Ball at 110% charge and minimum size.
Reward: 25,000 × 2.35^(tier-1) TP (max 1 billion, times the reward multiplier) and 5 + 4×tier evil alignment (max 35).
Collapse takes about 2.4 s for a moon, 4 s for a planet, 6 s for a gas giant and 10 s for a star, with debris asteroids flung out.
A collapsing star wipes out every unprotected world within 900 blocks. Players still standing on a destroyed world die (this even bypasses the Immortality wish).
Destroyed bodies stay destroyed (saved per world). Earth and Namek can't be erased.
Clients can see destruction effects up to 64,000 blocks away (space.destructionVisibilityRange).

features.name: Destroying Earth's Moon
features.summary: Earth's Moon is a destroyable tier-2 moon. Blowing it up changes life on Earth until it is wished back.
features.howToUse: Destroy it like any moon (needs 850M planet-busting power by default). To undo it, use a Moon Restoration Wish item (Shenron or Porunga wish 'Restore Earth's Moon').
details: While the Moon is gone: the Overworld is kept in a permanent thunderstorm, natural animal and water-animal spawning stops, and crops grow at roughly half speed (each growth tick has a 50% chance to fail).
The night sky renders without the Moon.
The Moon Restoration Wish puts it back in orbit and restores wildlife, weather and crops.

features.name: Space hazards: stellar heat, black holes, asteroids
features.summary: Deep Space has environmental dangers that scale with your strength.
features.howToUse: Keep away from stars and black holes, or be strong enough to resist them.
details: Stellar heat: within 420 blocks of a star's surface the screen heats up; within 260 blocks you take damage every second (about 0.5-6, or 10-20 inside the photosphere). High battle power relative to the star's integrity cuts this by up to 82%. Stars can't be landed on.

Black holes are very rare (roughly 1 in 1,400 sectors, kept thousands of blocks apart). Visual radius about 151 blocks (112 × 1.35 space.blackHoleScale); they pull you in from about 227 blocks, drain ki and stamina inside about 159 blocks, deal damage once both are empty near the core, and spending 5 seconds inside the event horizon (about 33 blocks) kills you.

Asteroids: there is a 28-rock belt in the home system and drifting asteroids elsewhere; ki blasts or ramming them shatters them and drops a few ore-type items (coal, raw iron/gold, redstone, amethyst, sometimes a diamond).
The server multiplier [v095.deepSpace] environmentDamageMultiplier scales or disables all of this damage.

features.name: Dead space and the Void Predator
features.summary: Flying too high or too low in Deep Space (below Y=0 or above Y=400) puts you in 'dead space', where a lethal hunter comes for you.
features.howToUse: Stay between Y=0 and Y=400 in Deep Space. If the heartbeat and 'SOMETHING IS LISTENING' warning appear, get back into safe space.
details: Exposure builds by 1 per tick in dead space and drains 8 times faster outside it. A heartbeat starts after 5 s and speeds up.
At 20 s you are warned to leave; at 45 s ('IT FOUND YOU') a Void Predator spawns and chases you (at most 4 hunters on the server at once).
It lunges in a 9-second rhythm; if it reaches within 24 blocks during a lunge it kills you outright (bypassing immortality) and flings you back toward safe space.
It fades away if you leave dead space, die or go into creative/spectator, and after 3 minutes at most.
Can be disabled with features.voidPredator=false.

features.name: Treasure Planet and the Astral Vault
features.summary: Each world has one hidden legendary Treasure Planet (tier 3, treasure forest surface) with a vault of loot under it, found only with a Treasure Locator.
features.howToUse: 1) Get a Treasure Locator (0.25% chance per completed planet mission). 2) Use it: the planet appears in your Galaxy Atlas for 5 minutes (only for you; use again to refresh). 3) Fly or autopilot there and land. 4) Use the locator within about 9 blocks of the triangular Astral Vault Gate near the landing clearing to open it, then walk through the doorway. 5) Walk back through the inner gate to leave.
details: The locator is tied to the world it came from; a locator from another world won't open the gate.
The vault is a 73×73 hall built about 134 blocks below the gate, with gold pillars, lava channels and 18 chests.
Each chest rolls 8-14 times from: gold ingots (12-48), gold blocks (2-8), emeralds (2-9), amethyst shards (8-32), diamonds (1-4) and golden apples (1-2).
If the Treasure Planet is destroyed the locator can no longer find it. Server switch: features.treasurePlanet.
Older worlds' separate treasure_vault dimension is kept only to move anyone inside it back out.

features.name: Super Dragon Balls & Super Shenron
features.summary: Seven Super Dragon Balls float in Deep Space. Gather all seven to summon Super Shenron for one wish.
features.howToUse: Craft a Super Dragon Ball Radar (Dragon Ball Radar + Namek Dragon Ball Radar, shapeless) or wish for one from Porunga. Right-click the radar to change its scope (auto, 1, 4, 16 or 40 km). Fly through Deep Space and pick up each ball. With all seven, the balls merge into the Super Shenron Summoning Emblem; use it in Deep Space to summon him and choose a wish from his menu.
details: Ball positions are fixed per world seed, within about ±16,000 blocks on X/Z at heights 80-289 in Deep Space.
Only one Super Shenron per owner at a time; you have 90 seconds to choose (wishes.superShenronChoiceSeconds). Keep the emblem in your inventory until the wish is granted.
After a wish the balls scatter again and come back after 5 minutes (6,000 ticks).
Testing commands: /noeaspace summon_shenron, /noea test dragonballs respawn.

features.name: Beerus' Planet
features.summary: Noea supplies the dmzsuper:beerus_planet dimension that Dragon Mine Z's Space Pod menu lists but never unlocks, builds Beerus' planet in it from a large map and turns it into a reachable destination.
features.howToUse: Wait for Beerus and Whis to visit the Overworld (checked every minute with a 1-in-180 chance while someone is in the Overworld; the visit lasts 5 minutes) and right-click either of them. Beerus' Planet is then marked in your Space Pod. Get in a Space Pod (H menu) and choose Beerus' Planet.
details: Travel is prepared server-side: arrival chunks are loaded and checked first, then you arrive at about x=31, y=69, z=30; if anything fails you are kept or returned safely.
First arrival sets your spawn point there and makes sure Master Beerus and Master Whis are present; they only teach you after you have travelled to their planet.

The planet is built in the background the first time from a 929×250×929-block map (about 14.2 million blocks in 12,801 templates over 3,110 chunk steps); progress messages are broadcast and the area stays force-loaded until done.
The planet has a purple sky (fixed daytime) and beds work. Unlocking also grants the 'Divine Coordinates' advancement and is a requirement for the God of Destruction path.
Admins: /noea test unlock beerus_planet [player].

features.name: Hell below Other World
features.summary: Noea deepens Dragon Mine Z's Other World downward and adds Hell beneath its clouds: purple basins, pale mineral groves, crimson rivers, steel ribs and thorn formations, with undead mobs.
features.howToUse: Stand on Other World's cloud surface and double-tap sneak (within about 0.45 s) to drop into Hell. To leave, fly up against the cloud ceiling for 2 seconds, or use Instant Transmission. Evil-aligned players must first defeat 30 hostiles in Hell.
details: Good and neutral players may come and go freely; evil-aligned players get a 'punishment' counter (default 30 kills, config hell.punishmentKills) and are pulled back down until it is cleared. Instant Transmission out always works.
Natural spawns are undead: zombies (weight 40), skeletons (35), husks (20), strays (8) and wither skeletons (3), packs up to 3. Normal mob caps, difficulty and doMobSpawning still apply.
Below the clouds you get basic DMZ flight on loan (Fly and Ki Control treated as level 1) if you haven't learned them; it is removed when you leave.
You get a 60-second fall-damage grace after descending.
The crimson Hell River fluid is swimmable and harmless. Hell Formation blocks (trees, maces, steel, river stones) are protected scenery and can't be broken or replaced.
The Faded Enma Gate block in Hell no longer works and tells you to return through the clouds.
Dragon Mine Z's death and revival system is unchanged; Hell doesn't change your revival status. Disable with features.hell=false.

features.name: Off-world inventory protection and vehicle recovery
features.summary: Optional protection that gives your inventory back if you die off-world, plus breaking your own Space Pod or Black Nimbus returns it to your inventory.
features.howToUse: Admins turn it on with /noea travel_safety offworld_inventory on (check with /noea travel_safety). It is separate from the keepInventory gamerule.
details: Protected dimensions: Deep Space, generated planet surfaces, Beerus' Planet, Namek and the Sacred Kai Planet.
On death there, your inventory and Curios slots are stored and restored when you respawn.
Hitting a Space Pod or Black Nimbus as a player puts the item straight into your inventory (or at your feet if full).

features.name: Space Pod additions
features.summary: Noea extends DMZ's Saiyan Space Pod for Deep Space.
features.howToUse: In Deep Space, right-click empty air while holding a Saiyan Space Pod to deploy it and board immediately.
details: New pod destinations: 'Deep Space' (always available) and Beerus' Planet (after the divine visit).
Pods get a cosmetic aura and wake trail at speed (toggle with /noea pod_aura).
Autopilot and the P 'Pro Cam' cinematic camera come from the Galaxy Atlas.
Deployment can be disabled with features.podAirDeployment=false.

features.name: Alien space stations
features.summary: Very rare sectors (about 1 in 401) contain an alien space station built from a schematic: abandoned, broken, or occupied by a Frieza Force garrison.
features.howToUse: Find them while exploring Deep Space.
details: About one in three stations is occupied and spawns Frieza soldiers; the rest are empty, and some of those are broken apart.
Stations are built gradually, about 1,000 blocks per tick.

features.name: Capsule Corp building
features.summary: One Capsule Corp building (built for Noea by ButterJaffa) appears per world in the Overworld and houses Fusion Expert Bulma and Butter, the Capsule Corp Form Designer.
features.howToUse: Explore; it can appear in newly loaded chunks at least 1,000 blocks from spawn and 320 blocks from the World Tournament (1-in-1,500 chance per chunk). Everyone is told when it appears. Use /noea capsule_corp locate to find it.
details: The site is surveyed for flat, clear ground before building; admins can force it with /noea test spawn capsule_corp [force] and remove it with /noea test unspawn capsule_corp.
Both NPCs are invulnerable, never despawn and are respawned if missing. Bulma opens the fusion expert menu; Butter opens the custom form creator (see Fusion and Created Forms).

features.name: Space save upgrade screen
features.summary: Opening a world with older or unversioned Noea space data shows a 'SPACE UPDATE REQUIRED' screen.
features.howToUse: Choose 'Back up & preserve space' (makes a full world backup first) or cancel to leave the world unopened.
details: Preserving keeps terrain, builds, stations, claims, planet names and identities, destruction state and inventories; only home-system markers move to the new layout.
A reset option archives the old space and planet-surface dimensions and moves affected players to the world spawn.
Backups go to a '-noea-backups' folder next to the save.

features.name: Noea boss family
features.summary: Noea adds its own boss character, Noea, plus three 'class' variants (Frieza, Cell, Kid Buu) and an unbound Destroyer variant. They are DMZ-style saga fighters (fly, combo, evade, Zanzoken, teal ki attacks) with fixed stats. None of them spawn naturally in this build.
features.howToUse: Get them from the 'Dragon Mine Z: Characters & Dev Tools' creative tab (spawn eggs), the datapack functions (/function noeabosses:spawn_frieza, spawn_cell, spawn_kid_buu, spawn_destroyer, spawn_all, give_spawn_eggs) or /noea test spawn <noea|frieza|cell|kid_buu>. Right-click the main Noea boss to start his duel; sneak + right-click him first to open a config screen.
details: The main Noea boss is passive and invulnerable until a player right-clicks him; he then says a few lines, waits 3 seconds (60 ticks) and becomes hostile toward that challenger with a purple boss bar.

Before the duel starts, any player within 12 blocks can sneak + right-click Noea to set his Power (1 to 2,147,483,647), Strength (1 to 250,000,000) and Max Health (1 to 1,000,000,000). Defaults: power 1,950,000,000, strength 160, health 12,000. No operator permission is checked. His ki blast damage becomes strength x 1.09375.
Noea takes at most 512 damage from any single hit and cannot be hurt before the duel starts.
Defeating the main Noea boss drops one Noea's Resolve (a trophy item); none of the other Noea bosses have a Noea loot table.

The Kid Buu class transforms into a pink 'beast' form at 50% health or when a hit would kill it: it refills to a new 52,000 max health, gets 2,048 attack, faster movement/attack speed, lightning and stronger ki attacks, and regenerates 25 health every half second.

The Destroyer / Unbound variant only ever takes 16 damage per hit; at 75% health it awakens a white/violet beast form with 250,000 max health that takes only 0.05 damage per hit and regenerates up to 250 health per second, so it is effectively unbeatable once awakened.
Noea boss models use the 'noea' GeckoLib model with a god-type teal aura; transformations are disabled except for the scripted beast awakenings.

features.name: Noea raids (Legendary Broly, Super Janemba, Beerus, Noea)
features.summary: Instanced 1-8 player boss raids fought in a dedicated arena dimension (noeabosses:legendary_arena). Each boss has three phases, telegraphed area attacks with on-screen instructions, and one or two signature mechanics. Clears give Legendary Cores and TP.
features.howToUse: Craft a Legendary Raid Sigil (iron ingots around an ender pearl) and use it, or type /noearaid, to open the raid board. Create or join a lobby, pick a boss and difficulty, ready up, and the leader starts. /noearaid leave exits or recovers you.
details: Party size 1-8; up to eight raid arenas can run at once. A lobby expires after 10 minutes (12,000 ticks) if never started.

Entry rules: you must have a created DMZ character, be alive, on foot, in Survival or Adventure, online and ready, and not in another encounter. Raids can be disabled server-side (features.raids in noeabosses-v1.toml).

Boss health is virtual: 1,200 x health multiplier x difficulty x (1 + 0.72 per extra player). One hit can remove at most 1.5% of max health. Damage dealt is x0.45 while an attack is active, x0.8 during a telegraph and x1.5 in an opening.
Phases change at 66% and 33% health. In the last phase the boss cannot be finished until its signature mechanic has been resolved.
Time limit 14,400 ticks (12 minutes); the boss enrages at 9,600 ticks (8 minutes): attacks come faster and deal x1.25 damage.

Boss attacks deal a fraction of each victim's own max health per hit (Story 14%, Standard 22%, Legendary 30%, x attack scale), cut to 60% while blocking, at most once every 12 ticks per player. Raid damage bypasses DMZ's normal combat damage maths.
Downed players can be revived by allies (about 3 seconds of channel); Story gives 2 revives, Standard and Legendary 1.
Optional 'phase echoes' (on by default): five small boss holograms spawn each phase; their health is 10% of the solo boss health and their hits do at most 3% of a victim's max health.
Raid bosses cannot be Flow-Stated: they counter that approach.

Noea registers each raid boss (with and without echoes) as a DMZ 2.2.1 native raid type (ids like noeabosses_broly_v1 / noeabosses_broly_echoes_v1), but they can only be started through /noearaid; trying to start them through DMZ's raid system tells you to use /noearaid.
Client options (noeabosses-raids-client.toml): reducedEffects (false), cameraShake (0.2, range 0-1), effectVolume (0.7).

features.name: Divine visitors (Beerus and Whis on Earth)
features.summary: Beerus and Whis (DMZ's own master NPCs) occasionally visit the Overworld for five minutes. Talking to either one unlocks Beerus's Planet as a Space Pod destination.
features.howToUse: Play in the Overworld and wait for the announcement ('A divine pressure settles over the area...'). Find the pair and right-click either of them. Operators can force a visit with /noea test spawn divine_visitors and unlock directly with /noea test unlock beerus_planet.
details: Every 1,200 ticks (1 minute) the server rolls a 1-in-180 chance while at least one non-spectator player is in the Overworld; on success the pair spawns 48 to 80 blocks from a random Overworld player.
The visit lasts 6,000 ticks (5 minutes); the visitors are invulnerable, persistent and named 'Beerus (Visiting Earth)' and 'Whis (Visiting Earth)'. Only one visit can be active at a time.

Right-clicking a visitor never opens DMZ's normal master dialogue; it grants the Beerus's Planet unlock and the 'Divine Coordinates' advancement. Beerus and Whis only teach you once you actually travel to their planet.
Players within 256 blocks are told the pair is visiting for five minutes.

features.name: God of Destruction path (Destroyer role)
features.summary: A late-game progression where a player trains under Beerus and Whis to become a Destroyer Candidate, then a God of Destruction Apprentice and finally an appointed God of Destruction with bounded Hakai attacks, Destruction Energy, a uniform and access to Ultra Ego.
features.howToUse: Meet the requirements, travel to Beerus's Planet and talk to Beerus or Whis (or press K, 'Open God of Destruction Menu', default key) to open the Destroyer Path screen. Begin candidacy, spar Whis repeatedly for training, complete the three trials, then talk to either Zeno at the Tournament of Power.
details: Default requirements (server config noeabosses-v095.toml, section destroyerProgression): Beerus's Planet unlocked, Buu Saga completed, God Ki training done, alive, not fused or absorbed, and not in a tournament or story fight. The path opens automatically once story and God Ki training are complete (checked every 5 seconds).
Ranks: Uninitiated, Destroyer Candidate, God of Destruction Apprentice, God of Destruction. Only Apprentices and Gods of Destruction have Destruction Energy and can use Hakai.

Whis training: each won matched-power spar against Whis gives 10 training points (config trainingPointsPerSession, 1-100) toward a maximum of 100, with a 30-second cooldown between sessions (trainingCooldownSeconds).
Trial 1 'Conquer / Liberate' (needs 25 training): land on a procedural Deep Space planet and either liberate or conquer it.

Trial 2 'Destroy That Planet' (needs 60 training): go back to Deep Space and destroy that same planet. If the planet was destroyed too early you must judge a new one; training is kept. Then return to Beerus or Whis to accept apprenticeship.

Trial 3 'Audience with Zeno' (needs 100/100 training): visit the Tournament of Power and right-click either Zeno; only Zeno can appoint you. A Candidate who has finished both planet trials and 100 training is promoted and appointed in one step.

On appointment you get the God of Destruction uniform (hue adjustable in 15-degree steps, toggleable), bounded Hakai, a '[God of Destruction]' name prefix (Apprentices get '[Destroyer Apprentice]'), and Beerus will then teach Ultra Ego for 75,000 TP.

Pools: one pool by default ('universe7'), with at most 1 appointed God of Destruction and 4 apprentices per pool (configurable 1-8 and 0-32). Operators can assign or revoke ranks with /noea v095 destroyer ...

Destruction Energy: cap 100 for an Apprentice and 200 for a God of Destruction; it regenerates 1 per second (Apprentice) or 2 per second (God of Destruction). While the Hakai aura is toggled on it drains 1 per second and the aura fades at 0.
Hakai aura damage bonus (folded into Noea's divine damage multiplier, capped at 32x overall): x1.5 for an appointed Destroyer, x1.25 for an Apprentice.

Hakai Sphere costs 25 energy (hakaiEnergyCost); Pure Hakai Beam costs half (12). Base Hakai damage is 24 Minecraft health (hakaiDamage), x0.6 for Apprentices and x0.8 for the beam; range 18 blocks; full armor penetration. Block damage is off by default (allowEnvironmentalHakai = false) and PvP Hakai is off by default (allowPvpHakai = false).

Hakai techniques registered as DMZ techniques usable by all races: Hakai Sphere (giant-ball type, damage multiplier 12, cast 36 ticks, cooldown 220), Pure Hakai Beam (laser, multiplier 9.6, cast 18, cooldown 150) and Hakai: Erasure Grab (multiplier 1, cast 1, cooldown 240). They cost 0 TP to learn.

Hakai: Erasure Grab: hold the assigned DMZ technique key to ready it; when an aimed target is within 3.35 blocks it is seized for 48 ticks; cooldown 240 ticks (config destroyer.erasureGrabRange / erasureGrabTicks / erasureGrabCooldownTicks in noeabosses-v1.toml).
Hakai is sealed during tournaments, story fights, absorption and protected training matches; during a fusion only the fusion's controller can use it.

Discipline: if an appointed God of Destruction erases a planet that was liberated, outside a sanctioned trial, it counts as misconduct. The first offence makes the Grand Priest appear with a one-time warning; the second makes Whis take you to the Tournament of Power, where Zeno erases your Destroyer office and kills your character (your world and items are not harmed). Logging out does not dismiss the hearing.
You can resign from the role from the Destroyer Path screen.

features.name: Tournament of Power
features.summary: A separate dimension (noeabosses:tournament_of_power) with a large stage, two Zenos and the Grand Priest. Speak to a Zeno to set up a 10-minute free-for-all of up to 20 fighters and teams; knock-outs and ring-outs eliminate fighters.
features.howToUse: Complete DMZ's Majin Buu Saga, then talk to Whis and choose 'Visit the Zenos' in the Noea Services menu. Party members alive and within 32 blocks of the leader come too. Talk to Zeno to build the roster; 'Return to Earth' takes you back.
details: The arena is assembled by the Grand Priest the first time someone travels there (about 6,000 blocks per tick); later visits go straight to the lobby.
Up to 20 fighters and up to 20 teams (team names up to 16 characters); each NPC slot can be given a random power scale between 0.05x and 20x.

3-second countdown, then 10 minutes (12,000 ticks). No flying. Falling below the stage (ring-out) or being knocked out eliminates you; leaving the arena also eliminates you. Creative/spectator players are immune.
If time runs out, the team with the highest summed remaining-health fraction wins.
Only the DMZ party leader can start a party Tournament of Power; only one Tournament of Power can run at a time.
Hitting Zeno: the first strike gets a puzzled reply, the second a warning, the third (within 30 seconds of the previous) erases you with a cosmic death that even immortality does not stop.
The Zenos and Grand Priest are invulnerable. The Zenos are also where Destroyer candidates are appointed.
No TP or item reward is coded for winning; the winner gets a victory title screen.

features.name: World Tournament court, Announcer and brackets
features.summary: Noea can build a World Martial Arts Tournament court in the Overworld with an invulnerable Announcer. The Announcer offers exhibition fights against the whole Noea fighter roster and lets a DMZ party host an 8-fighter single-elimination bracket.
features.howToUse: Build the site with /noea test spawn world_tournament [force] (operator level 2 or the singleplayer world owner), find it with /noea tournament locate, then right-click the Announcer. /noea tournament bracket opens the bracket screen.
details: In this build the court is never placed naturally: the natural-spawn code is empty, so it only appears through the test/admin command. If no court exists, exhibition and master spars use a temporary platform built in clear sky.
Two arena styles: 'Stage Battle' on the court and 'Sky Flying Battle' 36 blocks above it.
Placement surveys for flat, clear ground; the court self-repairs every 10 seconds when no match is running, and /noea test unspawn world_tournament removes only unchanged schematic blocks.

Brackets: exactly 8 entrants (players and/or NPC fighters), quarter-finals onward. The host must be the DMZ party leader within 16 blocks of the Announcer; all player fighters must join the party, stand within 32 blocks and press Ready. Player-vs-player matches need server PvP and the party's PvP option. Brackets can be disabled with features.tournamentBrackets in noeabosses-v1.toml.
Bracket matches end on time by remaining health. No TP reward is coded for brackets themselves.

features.name: Sparring with masters and the fighter roster
features.summary: Noea adds a 'Spar' option to DMZ master dialogue (via a 'Noea Services' screen) and a large curated roster of DMZ saga characters plus Noea-modelled extras (Super Broly, Frost, Universe 6 Saiyans, Gas, GT forms, Goku Black, Sonic, etc.). Winning gives TP.
features.howToUse: Talk to a supported DMZ master and pick Spar in the Noea Services panel, or use the World Tournament Announcer for any roster fighter. Choose a power mode, an arena and whether power-ups (mid-fight transformations) are on.
details: Masters with spar rosters: goku, vegeta, gohan, piccolo, trunks, frieza, cell, krillin, yamcha, gero, babidi, karin, roshi, oldkai, beerus, whis.
Opponent stats come from battle power: health = 100 x (BP / 1000)^0.55 (clamped 100 to 250,000,000), melee = 4.1% of that health, ki = 3.7%, then scaled by the power mode.

Power modes: Correct Stats (1x, the only mode that pays TP in tournaments), Easy 0.25x, Normal 0.6x, Hard 1.75x, Extreme 4x, Base Mod Power, and Match modes that copy your stats with 2x/3x/5x/10x health (Easy/Normal/Hard/Extreme multipliers configurable in noeabosses-v1.toml).
Server-wide multiplier tournament.npcPowerMultiplier (noeabosses-v095.toml, default 1.0, range 0.05-20).

With power-ups on, opponents transform at 45% health along a chain (e.g. Frieza first form -> second -> third -> final -> 100% full power), and a tournament win pays the sum of every stage's TP reward.

Master spars always pay the fighter's TP reward on a win (and count toward master-fusion wins); tournament exhibitions pay only in Correct Stats mode ('Custom-rule tournament: no TP awarded' otherwise).
Matches time out after 12,000 ticks (10 minutes). Parties of up to 4 players can enter exhibitions; everyone must be alive and within 32 blocks. Fusion/absorption must be undone first.
Tournament (Announcer) fighters unlock by story progress: each is gated by finishing the Saiyan, Frieza, Android, Buu, Future or Movies saga, and Noea's extra characters need every saga finished.
Sonic alternates every 50 seconds (1,000 ticks) between an invulnerable Super phase and a vulnerable base phase when power-ups are on.

features.name: Roaming story encounters
features.summary: While exploring, DMZ saga characters that fit your current story chapter can appear as neutral roaming sparring partners. Heroes and villains appear only when they would be alive at your point in the story.
features.howToUse: Explore new ground. Attack or engage an encounter to start a spar; either side yields at 5% health. Walk 48 blocks away to leave. Operators can list/spawn/clear test copies with /noea test encounters.
details: Server config noeabosses-story-encounters.toml: enabled (true), checkTicks 80, explorationBlocks 48 (minimum travel between attempts; revisiting the last 128 explored cells doesn't reroll), chance 0.35 per newly explored 64-block cell, nearbyLimit 2 within 128 blocks, dimensionLimit 24, lifetimeTicks 12,000, rematchTicks 1,200, storyStrength 1.0 (0.5-1.5, does not scale with player power), killEvilPenalty 20.
Candidates are taken from DMZ's saga quests (Saiyan, Frieza, Android, Buu, Future, Movies kill objectives), filtered by where you are (Earth, Namek, Hell, Otherworld, generated planet, moon).

Villains stop appearing after the saga chapter where they die (e.g. Raditz after Saiyan Saga chapter 1, Frieza after Frieza Saga 15, Cell after Android Saga 15). Heroes such as Goku, Piccolo, Krillin, Yamcha, Tien, Chiaotzu and Vegeta are absent while they are dead in the story.
Actually killing a roaming character (instead of making it yield) moves your alignment 20 points toward evil.
No separate Noea reward is coded for winning a roaming spar (unsure whether DMZ grants its own kill rewards here).

features.name: Anime waifu companions
features.summary: Eight invulnerable companion NPCs (Mitsuri Kanroji, Perona, Roxy, Chiaki, Frieren, Nami, Miku, Teto) that can be summoned by a wish, tamed with a diamond and then follow and fight for you.
features.howToUse: Use an Anime Waifu Wish item (or choose the matching Shenron/Porunga/Super Shenron wish). A random waifu appears next to you and you receive 5 diamonds. Right-click her with a diamond to bond. Sneak + right-click to cycle Follow / Stay / Wander. Use the Cry for Help Button or /noea cry_for_help to recall bonded companions.
details: Companions cannot be damaged. Base stats: 100,000 health, 450 attack, armor 30/20, battle power 25,000,000, ki blast 1,000,000.
Every second a bonded companion rescales to her owner: battle power = max(25,000,000, owner BP x 1.25) and ki damage = max(1,000,000, owner ki damage x 1.15), capped at 250,000,000.
She attacks whatever threatens her owner. In Follow mode she teleports to you beyond 20 blocks (or 12 blocks height difference); in Wander mode the leash is 24 blocks.
Right-clicking her with a Creeper Head makes her run away (removed); the head is not used up.
The Cry for Help Button is given automatically the first time you bond a companion. Using it recalls (or respawns) every bonded companion to you; 2-second cooldown.
Only one copy of each bonded companion stays active per owner.

features.name: Training Dummy
features.summary: An immortal, passive training target for practising combat and Ki sense.
features.howToUse: Operator-only: /noea dummy spawn <stationary|knockback|flight> [power], /noea dummy remove|pulse|power.
details: Three modes: Stationary (stays put), Knockback (can be launched) and Flight (follows its trainee's height).
1,000 max health, takes at most half of its max health per hit and does not die; optional sense battle power 1 to 1e18 (otherwise based on the trainee).

features.name: Canonical character spawn eggs and saga stat profiles
features.summary: A creative tab, 'Dragon Mine Z: Characters & Dev Tools', with about 150 spawn eggs for DMZ's own masters, saga characters and mobs (labelled '(Canonical)'), plus Noea's bosses and NPCs.
features.howToUse: Creative mode or /give. Eggs exist for every DMZ master (Goku, Vegeta, Piccolo, Gohan, Beerus, Whis, Roshi, Korin, Kaiosama, Enma, Dende, Popo, Guru, Gero, Babidi, Elder Kai, Cell, Frieza, Trunks, Yamcha, Krillin, Uranai, Toribot), saga fighters (Raditz through Super Janemba, Hirudegarn, Bojack, Broly forms, Androids 13-19...) and DMZ mobs (dinosaurs, sabertooth, Namek frogs, Red Ribbon robots, shadow dummy).
details: When a DMZ saga NPC spawns outside a DMZ quest (for example from these eggs or story encounters), Noea stamps it with fixed 'canonical' stats taken from DMZ 2.1.2's quest values (about 145 characters): e.g. Raditz 450 health / BP 87,678, Full Power Frieza 37,570 health / BP 120,000,000, Perfect Cell 217,000 health / BP 2,100,000,000, Kid Buu 770,000 health, Legendary Super Saiyan Broly 1,295,000 health, Super Janemba 1,225,000 health.
Quest-spawned NPCs keep DMZ's own quest stats, and Deep Space encounter NPCs keep their generated power.

features.name: New races: Sphinxian, Alien, Demon/Glind
features.summary: Three playable races added to DMZ's character creator, each with its own racial passive and three-stage form line.
features.howToUse: Sphinxian appears in race selection. Alien and Demon/Glind are hidden: on the race-selection or character screen press Up, Up, Down, Down, Left, Right, Left, Right; a 'Secret races unlocked' toast confirms.
details: Noea writes the race configs into config/dragonminez/races/{alien,demon,sphinxian} if they are missing.
Alien and Sphinxian share a stat table; Demon/Glind has its own.
The secret unlock is per client session and resets on logout. Existing characters of those races can always see their own race.

features.name: Post-Buu form gate
features.summary: Divine and late-game form families (God Forms, God Ki enhancement, Ultra Instinct, Ultra Ego, Frost Demon Golden/Black, both Bio-Data groups, Orange Piccolo, Divine Rosé, Beast) can't be learned or used until the Majin Buu saga is complete.
features.howToUse: Finish DMZ's Buu saga (saga quest 35).
details: Trying earlier shows a message and cancels any active gated form.

features.name: Created Forms (Capsule Corp Form Designer)
features.summary: Design up to two personal transformations with your own appearance and a 6-point combat profile.
features.howToUse: Find 'Butter - Capsule Corp Form Designer' at Capsule Corp (/noea capsule_corp locate). Stand within 12 blocks, buy a forge slot (Form I 500,000 TP, Form II 1,000,000 TP), then design and save the form. Select it under Extra Forms.
details: Spend 6 points across Power, Guard and Speed (0-3 each).
Form I: damage x(1.25 + 0.25 per Power point), incoming damage divided by (1 + 0.15 per Guard point), +3% move speed per Speed point.
Form II: damage x(1.6 + 0.3 per Power point), guard 1.15 + 0.18 per point, +4% speed per point.
Ki upkeep per second: max Ki x (0.4% for Form I or 0.6% for Form II, plus 0.1% per point spent), cut by up to half as form mastery reaches 100. The form ends when Ki runs out.
Appearance editor: hair style, aura style, hair/body/eye/aura colours, anatomy parts, scale.
The forms' DMZ config multipliers are all 1.0; Noea applies the profile itself. Bought from a master at price -1 (special handling).

features.name: Saiyan Blue awakening
features.summary: Super Saiyan Blue and Blue Evolved have to be awakened in combat, not just bought.
features.howToUse: Buy the God Forms level. In SSG select Super Saiyan and transform to awaken Blue. In SSG or Blue select SSJ2 and transform to awaken Blue Evolved.
details: The world switch is /noea traits blue_requirements on|off (on by default). Fused characters and Glind-in-Saiyan bodies skip it.

features.name: Enhance with God Ki
features.summary: A stack form for every race that turns supported base forms into named God Ki versions.
features.howToUse: Buy it from Beerus, Whis or the Grand Priest (600,000 TP), go into a supported form, then stack it.
details: 69 recognised race/form combinations. The variant name appears in the action bar when you activate it.

features.name: Rare traits
features.summary: Rolled once when a character is created: Mutant (1%, Saiyans), Mythic Saiyan (0.05%, one per save) and Heart Disease (0.1%).
features.howToUse: Automatic. Admins manage them with /noea traits.
details: Each trait has a world on/off switch (all on by default); turning one off keeps saved rolls.
Heart disease can also come from repeatedly using Super Saiyan before mastering it, and DMZ's Heart Medicine cures it.

features.name: Majin absorption
features.summary: Majins (and Humans in Majin Android form) throw goo to absorb weakened enemies, permanently gaining part of their power and possibly copying a form.
features.howToUse: Press 'Majin Absorption Goo' (default B) or use the 'Majin Absorb' menu entry. Hit a target, weaken it to 35% HP or less, then hit it again.
details: Throwing costs 25% of max Ki and has a 10-second cooldown (200 ticks); each goo hit deals 5% of the target's max HP.

A successful absorb permanently adds 35% of the target's power, melee damage and Ki damage. There is a 75% chance to copy the target's form into one of 4 slots (/noea absorption list or remove <1-4>).
Androids, Bio-Androids, Cell, Gero and similar synthetic fighters can't be absorbed.
Players must opt in with /noea absorption consent on (off by default). Absorbing a player outside a tournament kills them.
Using an absorbed form: x1.2 damage dealt, x0.9 damage taken (config defaults).
Server switch: features.majinAbsorption.

features.name: Evil Third Eye (Demon, W.I.P)
features.summary: An item only a Demon can install. It stores power from combat and lets you grow into three bigger, stronger forms.
features.howToUse: Get the item from Shenron or Porunga and right-click it as a Demon. Fight to fill it to 1,000 stored power, then press the Evil Eye / Fusion Transform key (default U) to go up a form; sneak+U powers down. Toggle the look with /noea demon evil_eye on|off.
details: Power gained per hit = damage as a share of the victim's max HP x 250, times the square root of the power ratio between you and the victim (clamped between 0.25 and 8). Stronger foes charge it faster.
Forms 1/2/3: 2x/4x/8x size and reach, with a matching 2x/4x/8x damage multiplier. Noea caps all of its damage multipliers combined at 32x.
Filling form 3 to 1,000 starts a 60-second overload. Afterwards the eye tears free: you drop to 5% HP with no Ki or stamina and can't use it for 10 minutes.
Marked W.I.P in its item name.

features.name: Glind body wish / player body exchange
features.summary: A Demon/Glind can wish Super Shenron for a Saiyan body, or swap bodies with a consenting Saiyan player.
features.howToUse: As an unfused Demon/Glind in base form, summon Super Shenron and pick the body wish. To swap with another player, that Saiyan first runs /noeaswap consent <your name> (/noeaswap revoke cancels).
details: Needs server PvP, the same dimension and both players within 320 blocks.
Gives the Divine Rosé form route; God and Blue become unavailable.
Server switches: features.glindBodyWish, wishes.consentingPlayerBodySwap.

features.name: Wish cooldowns and wish-list upgrades
features.summary: Per-player wish cooldowns on multiplayer servers. Noea's wishes are merged into each world's DMZ wish files.
features.howToUse: Automatic. /noea test dragonballs cooldowns on|off toggles them.
details: Cooldowns: Shenron 600 s, Porunga 1,200 s, Super Shenron 300 s (server config noeabosses-v1.toml, wishes.*CooldownSeconds). Not applied in single-player.

When the server starts, Noea adds its wishes to <world>/dragonminez/wishes/shenron.json and porunga.json, keeps any custom entries, and backs up the old file as *.before-noea-<time>.bak (wishes.upgradeOldLists).

features.name: Spirit Bomb infusion
features.summary: A Saiyan can absorb their own over-charged Spirit Bomb instead of throwing it.
features.howToUse: As a Saiyan in exact Base, Super Saiyan or Super Saiyan Blue (no stack form), charge DMZ's Spirit Bomb to 175% and press the Evil Eye / Fusion Transform key (U) without sneaking.
details: Names: Spirit Infusion (base), Spirit Super Saiyan (SSJ), Universal Blue (Blue).
4-second absorb, then it lasts 120 s (base), 90 s (SSJ) or 60 s (Blue).
Blocked during fusion, Majin absorption, Flow State, Super Dash or sparring.
Unsure: no extra stat multiplier for this state was found in the server code; it may be mainly a timed visual state.

features.name: Flow State (Close Range Combat)
features.summary: A server-run, cinematic close-quarters exchange: you lock a target into a short flurry of rapid light strikes and heavy finishers that the defender can answer.
features.howToUse: Buy the 'flowstate' skill (1 level, 100,000 TP) from Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, Krillin, Trunks, Yamcha or Master Roshi. With an empty main hand, hold the Flow State Modifier key (Left Alt) and left-click a target under the reticle; keep clicking during the exchange to send attack pulses.
details: Initiation range 15 blocks (config initiationRange); the target must be under the server-checked reticle with line of sight.
Costs a flat 5 DMZ stamina (staminaCost) and 0 ki (energyCost) to start; 60-tick (3 s) cooldown after an accepted request.
An exchange lasts 24-44 ticks (server picks), then a 6-10 tick recovery before either fighter can re-enter.
Each light strike deals 5% of a fully aimed empty-hand punch; each heavy finisher deals 20%.
At most 8 accepted attack pulses per second per participant; up to 8 ticks of latency compensation.

NPCs can start Flow State on you: 1% chance per check every 5 ticks, +50% chance per difficulty step above Easy. NPCs answer an exchange 40% of the time (+15% per difficulty step) and always answer the final beat by default.
Allowed inside Noea World Tournament arenas by default; refuses targets DMZ marks friendly (party PvP off); same-scoreboard-team fights are off by default.

A Flow 'spectacle tier' 0-3 (normal, Super Saiyan, SSJ3+, Blue/Legendary) is taken from the fighters' forms/power. Tier 2+ emits ring shockwaves that break nearby blocks with hardness up to 35 (max 320 blocks per wave, 96 per server tick). Unsure whether this respects any griefing gamerule.
Trying it on the Legendary Broly raid boss makes him counter instead (100-tick cooldown).
Not gated by /noea experimental; it only needs the skill and the server switch closeRangeCombat 'enabled' (default true).
Client visuals (particles, flashes, camera shake 0.2, orbit 0.35) are in noeabosses-client.toml [closeRangeCombat].

features.name: Super Dash and Fly Clash
features.summary: A long-range lunge at an aimed target that ends in a knockback impact, with curved and behind-the-target variants; some NPCs dash back for a mid-air clash.
features.howToUse: Buy 'superdash' from one of the eight Z-fighter masters (level 1 = 50,000 TP, level 2 = 150,000 TP). Double-tap the Super Dash key (R, shared with DMZ's dash) within 0.05-0.65 s while aiming at a target. Hold W for a forward arc, A or D for a side arc, S for a blind-side dash behind the target (level 2 only); no direction = straight.
details: Target search up to 104 blocks along your aim; 10-tick wind-up; the dash can travel for up to 58 ticks.
Impact deals about 1.05x your attack-damage attribute and launches the target away.
18-tick cooldown after a normal dash (hard ceiling 40 ticks).

Fly Clash: if you dash at a DMZ saga NPC, alien inhabitant or tournament/sparring fighter, it may counter-dash (always for sparring/tournament fighters or a mob already targeting you, otherwise 42%) and you meet in a 10-tick mid-air clash.

Ordinary vanilla mobs never counter unless an admin runs /noea fly_clash vanilla_mobs on (stored in config/noeabosses-fly-clash.json, allowVanillaMobCounters = false by default). Animals never counter.
A client-only chase camera lags behind at take-off (superDashCamera: 20 catch-up ticks, lag strength 1.0) and a small third-person reticle marks long-range targets.
The Super Dash aura visual can be toggled with /noea dash_aura.

features.name: Noea Styled Combat (experimental combos, Combo Ender, Combat Pursuit)
features.summary: An opt-in replacement for DMZ empty-hand melee: a five-contact combo chain with lunges, heavy enders, launches and pursuit dashes.
features.howToUse: Run /noea experimental combat on (or /noea experimental on for combat and grabs). Fight with both hands empty. Left-click = light strikes; right-click or the Combo Ender key (default O) = heavy/ender (hold to charge for up to 1 s); double-tap R during a fight = Combat Pursuit (hold S for a rear pursuit).
details: Off by default per character; turning it off cleans up active combat state.
A combo gauge shows five server-confirmed contacts (client option combat.comboGauge, default true).
Damage is a fraction of DMZ's native punch: light 18%, heavy 35%, finisher 45% (config experimentalExchange).

Enders depend on how many contacts you have landed: 1 or 4 = Kick Away, 2 = Heavy Stagger, 3 = Turnaround Strike, 5th contact = Kick Away Finisher. Kick Away launches 10 blocks, the finisher 14 blocks, each plus up to 5 blocks at full charge.
Wind-ups: light 5 ticks, heavy 7 ticks, plus up to 3 ticks of ping allowance for the defender.
The approach lunge reaches 7 blocks in the air, 2.5 on the ground; one buffered press is kept for 8 ticks.
Stamina costs are fractions of max stamina: light up to 1.2% (floor 0.3%), heavy 3%, finisher 2%, approach 0.6%.
Combat Pursuit (needs Super Dash level 1; rear needs level 2) chases a target up to 24 blocks away; front costs 2% stamina + 2% ki, rear 3.5% stamina + 4% ki.
While a player is opted in, NPC melee attacks against them get a short visible wind-up so they can be read and Step Vanished.

features.name: Step Vanish
features.summary: A timed defensive vanish: tap Block just before an incoming melee hit to blink out of it; holding Block still guards normally.
features.howToUse: Requires /noea experimental combat on and empty hands. Buy 'stepvanish' from Goku (50,000 TP), then start the lesson from the Step Vanish entry in DMZ's Ki Actions radial (utility menu, X) while standing within 6 blocks of Goku, and land 3 of 5 timed escapes. Afterwards tap the DMZ Block key (right mouse) just before a hit lands.
details: Timing window: the press must come no more than 3 ticks before impact (ping up to 200 ms is allowed for).
Each vanish costs 4% max stamina and 5% max ki; each further reversal within 60 ticks multiplies the cost by 1.35, up to four times.
A successful vanish gives a short protected window and can chain (chain budget 24 ticks, max age 60 ticks).
The camera holds at the departure point for 20 ticks and eases back over 6 ticks (noeabosses-universe-effects.toml); reduced motion disables it.
Mobs that are stun-locked by Step Vanish lose their navigation for the duration.

features.name: Grab, carry and throw (experimental)
features.summary: Grab a nearby fighter, carry them, then set them down or charge a throw that can crash into terrain.
features.howToUse: Run /noea experimental grab on. Press Grab (Z by default, the same key as DMZ lock-on) on a target in reach. While holding: hold left-click to charge a throw and release to throw; right-click to set the victim down; press Z again to release. A grabbed player escapes by mashing attack, right-click or Z.
details: Reach 3.35 blocks.

Throw charge fills in 40 ticks (2 s); throw speed rises from 1.85 to 4.8; a charge of 25% or more makes a crash crater of roughly 1.15-3.2 block radius (at most 64 blocks destroyed). A held charge auto-releases after 100 ticks.
Breakout needs 8 presses (6 against some top-tier holders), at most 12 counted per second; a broken grab gives the holder a 15 s (300-tick) grab lockout.
Anchored training dummies cannot be carried away.
Hakai's close-range erasure grab (God of Destruction role) reuses this system; see the Destroyer section.

features.name: Sonic Break (fast flight)
features.summary: Two extra flight-speed tiers on top of DMZ flight, with sonic-boom visuals.
features.howToUse: While flying, double-press the Sonic Break key (Left Ctrl) within 7 ticks. Requires DMZ Fly skill level 8 or higher; the second tier (Double Break) needs Fly at its maximum level. Press again to stop.
details: Tier 1 = native fly-sprint speed x1.3 (cap 4.5); tier 2 = x1.65 (cap 6.0). Server config flight.sonicSprintMultiplier (1.3, range 1.1-2.0) and flight.doubleBreakSprintMultiplier (1.65, range 1.2-2.5).
Base speed scales with DMZ Fly level (+20% per level) and the fly-speed attribute, and is multiplied by DMZ's gravity flight factor; DMZ gravity that hard-stops flight also blocks Sonic Break.
Drain every 10 ticks: tier 1 = 1.5% max ki + 0.7% max stamina; tier 2 = 2.5% max ki + 1.2% max stamina. Running out ends it.
Not usable while blocking, charging ki or techniques, stunned, during atmosphere travel or with a ki weapon out. Starting a DMZ melee attack also stops it.
Visuals and boom volume: noeabosses-universe-effects.toml (sonicFlight = ALL, boomVolume 0.5).

features.name: Universe Sense (Ki Sense rework) and lock-on cycling
features.summary: Replaces DMZ's Ki Sense alerts with a server-side signature scanner that shows nearby power as coloured auras, threat labels and a trackable signal.
features.howToUse: Needs DMZ's Ki Sense skill, or a scouter worn in the Curios head_tech slot. DMZ's Ki Sense key (F4) cycles sense modes; open Scan / Track from Ki Actions (utility menu, X) or bind the unbound 'Scan / Track' key to pick a signature to track. Cycle Lock-On Target (N) switches DMZ lock-on between nearby targets.
details: Scans every 5 ticks, up to 128 blocks; up to 24 signals and 64 master waypoints shown.
Threat label compares the source's released power to yours: Weaker (below 0.65x), Comparable, Stronger (above 1.6x), Overwhelming (above 5x).
Scouter-only users have a 50-block range and can only read signatures up to 150,000,000 power; reading an exact number also needs the Bulma scouter-calibration quest, line of sight and 20 blocks.
Players in God forms are hidden from observers without the God Forms skill; anti-ki cloaks and upgraded androids are undetectable; server option detectPlayers (default true).
Sense only works within the same realm (same dimension and, on generated planets, the same planet).

Lock-on cycling needs Ki Sense: range 15 + 5 per Ki Sense level (+25 for upgraded androids) in a 44-degree cone. Noea also makes DMZ's own lock-on (Z) pick the best target and aim correctly at giant or scaled bodies.
Client options: detectionSound 0.55, detectionFlash 0.45, cameraMotion 0.35, reducedMotion false (noeabosses-sense-client.toml).

features.name: Senzu Pouch
features.summary: A bought pouch that stores Senzu Beans for one-key healing, plus throwing beans to allies.
features.howToUse: Talk to Korin (Karin) and buy pouch tiers in order. Store or withdraw beans from the Senzu slot in DMZ's utility menu (X): left-click deposits one bean, right-click withdraws one. Press Use Senzu Pouch (Y) to eat; hold Left Alt + Y to throw a bean.
details: Tier prices 5,000 / 25,000 / 75,000 / 200,000 TP; minimum character level 1 / 10 / 25 / 50 (config senzuPouch).
Capacity 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 beans.
Eating restores full health, ki and stamina; it is refused if you are already full.
Cooldown is the larger of Noea's useCooldownTicks (100) and DMZ's senzuCooldownTicks (240 in this instance), so 12 s here.
A thrown bean lands in an allowed ally's inventory on hit; otherwise it drops as an item (the projectile lives 100 ticks).
Alt + Y while holding a left Potara earring force-throws the Potara instead (fusion feature).

features.name: Power-up shockwaves and ki pressure
features.summary: Strong characters blast a pushing shockwave when they transform or snap to full power release, and charging shows pressure rings that scale with power.
features.howToUse: Automatic. Transform (power rising over 5%) or go from low to full power release within 6 s while above 2,100,000 battle power.
details: Shockwave radius 6 blocks; pushes others up to 9 blocks (only 0.8 if they are blocking); 60-tick cooldown; no damage.
'Full release' means 50% + 5% per Potential Unlock level (at least 100%).
Pressure rings and trails are visual only (max radius 8 blocks) and scale with released power on a log curve.
Visibility per player: noeabosses-universe-effects.toml (shockwaves = ALL, combatFlash, combatShake 0.5).

features.name: Ultra Instinct dodging and Ultra Ego rage
features.summary: Noea's combat rules for DMZ's Ultra Instinct and Ultra Ego stack forms.
features.howToUse: Automatic while the stack form is active.
details: Ultra Instinct Sign: 50% chance to auto-dodge a hit, 75% once Sign mastery reaches 100 ('True Ultra Instinct').
Mastered Ultra Instinct: dodge chance uses the power-difference rule (100% against weaker foes; against stronger foes 1 - 0.15 x log2(ratio), never below 50%).
Each dodge costs 7% of max stamina, falling to 1.5% at full mastery; no stamina, no dodge.
Ultra Ego: outgoing damage rises as your health drops and as rage builds, up to x3.1.
Dodges play an afterimage cue and sound (/noea dodge_sound; client option ultraInstinctDodge presentationMode full / reduced / off).

features.name: Candy Beam
features.summary: Majin Buu's beam that turns a weakened target into candy.
features.howToUse: Majin characters, or humans with the Majin Android form, buy Candy Beam from Mr. Popo (150,000 TP); Noea moves it from Buu's offering list to Popo's. Equip and fire it like any DMZ ki technique.
details: Laser technique: damage multiplier 3.0, speed 4.5, size 0.58, 100 armour penetration, base cost 0.14, 22-tick cast, 100-tick cooldown.
Mobs must be at or below 75% health and players at or below 10%, unless you are 10x stronger.
Success chance: 100% against weaker targets; against stronger ones 1 - 0.15 x log2(their power / yours), never below 50%.
A converted target spins into candy over 36 ticks and drops no normal loot. Candy roll: 5% Creeper Cookie; villagers 10% Chocolate Villager; otherwise Chocolate, Pretzel or Donut.
Kills made by an active Majin Android also turn victims into candy.

features.name: Ki cooking
features.summary: Shooting a ki blast through dropped raw food cooks it.
features.howToUse: Drop smeltable food on the ground and fire any DMZ ki projectile through it.
details: Uses the vanilla furnace recipe and only applies when the result is edible; whole stacks convert and overflow spills as extra items.

features.name: Physical size for giant forms
features.summary: When Evil Eye forms or fusions make your model bigger, your hitbox, camera and step height grow with it.
features.howToUse: Automatic.
details: Hitbox scales with the visual scale (minimum 0.25x).
Step height gains 0.6 blocks per extra 1x of scale, up to +4.2.
Third-person camera height and distance are rescaled.

features.name: Toggle Aura, flight trails, dash and pod aura
features.summary: Quality-of-life toggles for DMZ's permanent aura and Noea's flight visuals.
features.howToUse: The Toggle Aura key (V) flips DMZ's permanent aura on or off (needs the Ki Control skill). /noea trails, /noea dash_aura, /noea pod_aura and /noea dodge_sound toggle per-character visuals.
details: Noea re-renders DMZ's flight aura in screen space with per-angle offset options (noeabosses-client.toml [nativeFlightAura]).
Nimbus riders stand upright (nimbus.standingPose, default true).

features.name: /noea experimental opt-ins
features.summary: Per-character switches for the unfinished combat systems.
features.howToUse: /noea experimental shows clickable [ON]/[OFF] rows for 'Noea Styled Combat (combos / Step Vanish)' and 'Grabs (carry / throw)'. /noea experimental on|off sets both.
details: Both default to OFF.
Turning combat off stops styled combat, Step Vanish and the combat-practice recorder; turning grabs off drops any active grab.
/noea combatpractice on|off|export records a combat/resource ledger for testing; /noea tpdebug reports training-point factors.

features.name: Realistic Mode
features.summary: A world-wide 'anime-accurate' balance profile: huge form multipliers, much tougher story enemies, tiered TP form prices and saga milestone TP payouts.
features.howToUse: The server owner turns it on with the gamerule noeaRealisticMode true, or /noea realism on (op). /noea realism progression on|off changes only the future-progression half. Off by default. Changes are applied in memory and undone when switched off; DMZ config files are not rewritten.
details: Form multipliers (all stats except speed are set to the same value): Super Saiyan and SSJ Mastered x50, SSJ Grade 2 x65, Grade 3 x80, SSJ2 x100, SSJ3 x400, SSJ4 and Blue x2,500, SSG x1,600, Blue Evolved and Beast x5,000, Rose x3,125, Rose Evolved x6,250, Oozaru x10, Golden Oozaru x500, LSSJ and SSJ Full Power x250, Ultimate x550, Enhance with God Ki x400.

Stack forms: Kaioken x2 / x3 / x4 / x10 / x20 (Kaioken no longer boosts vitality), Ultra Instinct Sign x5,000 and other Ultra Instinct / Ultra Ego forms x10,000, Golden Frieza x2,500, Black Frieza x10,000.

Race forms (examples): Frieza 2nd x2, 3rd x10, Final x35, Full Power x50, Fifth x100; Cell Semi-Perfect x50, Perfect x80, Super Perfect x150, Ultra Perfect x300, Corrupted Giant x500; Namekian Giant x2, Full Power x10, Super Namekian x65; Majin Evil x65, Super x120, Ultra x275, Kid x350; Human Buffed x2, Full Power x5, Overdrive x65, Solaris x400; android forms x50 / x100 / x150, Gamma x400, Gamma 120 x480, Gamma 150 x500; Demigra x1,600 / x2,500 / x5,000; Alien, Demon and Sphinxian tiers x50 / x100 / x400. Created (custom) forms are left unchanged.
Every form's max-stats multiplier is forced to 1.0; Super Saiyan Mastered has no ki, stamina or health drain; Namekian Full Power, Super Namekian and android forms have no ki drain.
Majin pure forms are re-ordered Evil > Super > Ultra > Kid, unlocked at skill levels 1-4, each needing the previous form, 25% mastery to unlock and 50% for free transform.

While transformed: stamina per punch scales with your STM multiplier (at least 4% of max stamina plus half your regen per second); ki technique costs scale with your ENE multiplier; form ki upkeep has a floor tied to max ki (capped at 5%); passive ki regen is limited to 25% of the drain; Kaioken health regen is limited to 25% of its drain.

Story balance ON (default, realism.storyBalance): story enemies are scaled by saga tier (base x1, Frieza 1st/2nd/3rd x2/x4/x8, Oozaru x10, SSJ-tier x50, Full Power Frieza x62.5, SSJ2-tier x100, Legendary Broly x250, SSJ3-tier/Buu/Janemba x400, God tier x1,600, Blue/Golden Frieza tier x2,500), measured against benchmark quest fights (Nappa, Vegeta, Ginyu, Frieza, Cell, Buu and others) and party size.

Story balance ON: TP gain x3 (storyTpGainMultiplier; Frost Demons get an extra x1.5) and tiered form prices, for example Saiyan super forms 1M / 600k / 700k / 1M / 1.5M / 3M / 3.5M / 5M TP, Saiyan God forms 5M / 8M / 12M / 15M, Beast 12M, Human and Namekian super forms 400k / 1M / 1.5M / 3M, Frost Demon 200k / 300k / 500k / 600k / 1M.

Story balance ON: fixed milestone TP replaces the normal TP/attribute rewards of key saga quests: Saiyan Saga quest 11 = 150,000; Frieza Saga quests 10 and 15 = 500,000, quest 13 = 800,000; Android Saga quest 11 = 480,000, quest 12 = 1,360,000, quest 14 = 1,200,000; Buu Saga quest 17 = 2,400,000 (adjusted by price multiplier and difficulty, and divided by the TP multiplier). Chat shows 'Realistic story reward: +N TP'.
Story balance ON: the movie saga gets an extra 50-kill Metal Cooler horde quest and the Bojack tournament clean-up quest is replaced.
Story balance OFF (legacy keys): enemy health x3, enemy damage x1.5, TP gain x0.5, form prices x10.
The keys storyEnemyHealthMultiplier (6.0) and storyEnemyDamageMultiplier (1.5) exist, but the code path seen uses the per-saga tiers instead (unsure).
DMZ shadow dummies are never scaled. Fractional TP is carried over between gains.

features.name: Training points (TP) changes
features.summary: What Noea changes about how TP is earned and spent.
features.howToUse: Check your own numbers with /noea tpdebug (ops: /noea tpdebug <player>).
details: Kill TP is capped for big enemies: DMZ normally uses the victim's max health x tpHealthRatio (0.25 in this instance); Noea feeds it a 'health budget' of min(health, 8 x sqrt(health), 2048), using the victim's health before Realistic scaling. Enemies up to 64 HP are unchanged; a 10,000 HP boss counts as 800 HP; the budget never exceeds 2,048.

Passive TP (DMZ: passiveTpGain every 5 s with PASSIVE boosts) is routed through a Noea hook but the amount is unchanged. /noea tpdebug estimates TP per 30 minutes and lists the class, racial, gravity, weights, potion, mutant, HTC and stat-cost factors.

Gravity and weights: Noea does not change DMZ's gravity-device or weighted-clothing TP multipliers; they still apply as configured in DMZ (tpGainBoosts lists 'gravity' and 'weights' for every TP source). Moon surfaces get lighter physical gravity (see changesToDmz), which is not a training multiplier.
Realistic Mode multiplies all TP gains (x3 with story balance, x0.5 legacy) and adds saga milestone payouts (see realistic-mode).

Extra TP sources Noea adds: raids (1,000 TP per difficulty step by default, raids.trainingPointsPerDifficulty), destroying planets, stars and moons (25,000 x 2.35^(tier-1) x reward multiplier, and 5 + 4 x tier alignment lost, max 35), planet missions, sparring and tournament wins.
TP purchases Noea adds: Super Dash 50,000 / 150,000, Flow State 100,000, Step Vanish 50,000, Candy Beam 150,000, Senzu Pouch tiers, plus new form skills (see racesAndForms).

DMZ shadow-dummy training is made safe: each hit from your shadow is capped at 15% of your max health and the session ends at 5% health instead of knocking you out; the shadow's health, damage and BP re-sync to your live stats (split shadows 25-75%).
Noea's own Training Dummy (/noea dummy spawn ...) is immortal, takes at most 50% of its max health per hit, and has a settable sense BP of 1 to 1e18.

features.name: Noea config files
features.summary: Where Noea's settings live and the key defaults.
features.howToUse: Server configs (noeabosses-v090.toml, -v095.toml, -v1.toml, -close-range-combat.toml, -story-encounters.toml, -sense-server.toml) are per world in saves/<world>/serverconfig; defaultconfigs/noeabosses-v095.toml ships with the jar. Client configs are in config/. Run /noea v095 validate after editing custom definitions.
details: noeabosses-v1.toml (examples): wish cooldowns Shenron 600 s / Porunga 1200 s / Super Shenron 300 s; Super Shenron choice timeout 90 s; raids healthMultiplier 1.0, damageMultiplier 1.0, trainingPointsPerDifficulty 1000, phase echoes on; tournament health x2 / x3 / x5 / x10 (easy / normal / hard / extreme); absorption permanentPowerFraction 0.35, formCopyChance 0.75, target at or below 35% health, goo cooldown 200 ticks; Hakai grab range 3.35, 48 ticks, cooldown 240; moon gravity on (Earth's Moon 0.35, generated moons 0.4); Hell on, punishment kills 30; treasure planet on (mission key chance 25 per 10,000); body-swap consent 2400 ticks; realism block (see realistic-mode); feature switches for raids, brackets, absorption, pod autopilot, pod air deployment, alien settlements, void predator and planet climate.

noeabosses-v090.toml: master fusion needs 5 completed sparring wins against that master; fusion lasts 18,000 ticks (15 min), Potara x2 duration, cooldown 18,000 ticks; fused damage out x1.35 / in x0.85; fusion technique 12% max ki, 0.65x ki damage, 80-tick cooldown, 24-block range; fusion dance 8 inputs in 240 ticks; Demon passive triggers below 35% target health, 6% leech, 600-tick cooldown; Majin absorption range 8, damage out x1.2 / in x0.9; Senzu pouch prices and levels; 8 action requests per second. trainingPointCost 100000 is a legacy key (master fusion no longer charges TP).

noeabosses-v095.toml: deep space enabled, power / enemy / environment / planet / moon reward multipliers 1.0; tournament npcPowerMultiplier 1.0; player Arm Band fusion requests and cross-race Arm Band fusion on; custom form and planet JSON on (max 512 forms, 32 planets, multiplier ceiling 100); Destroyer pools 'universe7', 1 Destroyer and 4 apprentices per pool, needs Beerus planet unlock + Buu Saga + God Ki training, PvP Hakai off, environmental Hakai off, Hakai energy cost 25, damage 24.
noeabosses-close-range-combat.toml: Flow State settings (see flow-state) plus the [experimentalExchange] styled-combat values.

noeabosses-story-encounters.toml: roaming story encounters on; check every 80 ticks; 35% chance per new 64-block cell after 48 blocks of travel; max 2 nearby and 24 per dimension; idle life 12,000 ticks; rematch 1,200 ticks; storyStrength 1.0; killing one costs 20 alignment.

noeabosses-sense-server.toml: detectPlayers true. noeabosses-sense-client.toml, noeabosses-universe-effects.toml, noeabosses-raids-client.toml and noeabosses-client.toml hold client visuals only (the live copies match defaults except pod.cinematicCamera = false).
