features.name: Dev tool items (creative tab)
features.summary: A set of right-click testing items in the 'Dragon Mine Z: Characters & Dev Tools' creative tab that instantly edit your DMZ character. They are meant for testing, not normal play.
features.howToUse: Take them from the creative tab (or /give) and right-click. The items themselves do no permission check, so anyone holding one can use it.
details: Max Stats: sets all six DMZ stats to 100,000,000, TP to 2,000,000,000 and gives 2,000,000,000 unspent attribute points.
Unlock All Skills: raises every DMZ skill to its max level and also grants God Forms 3, Beast Forms, Ultra Instinct 2, Ultra Ego, Hakai and Frost Demon God Forms 2.
Unlock Every Technique: unlocks a copy of every predefined DMZ ki and strike technique.
Max All Mastery: sets mastery of every form and stack form of your race to its maximum (100 if unspecified).
Good / Neutral / Evil Alignment: sets alignment to +100 / 0 / -100.
Complete Story: marks DMZ story progress as complete. Full Restore: refills your resources.

Power presets (sets all six stats, TP = max(100,000, 20 x stat) and refills): Saiyan Saga 1,500 (500 in Realistic Mode), Frieza Saga 20,000 (1,000), Cell Saga 150,000 (2,000), Buu Saga 750,000 (3,000), Dragon Ball Super 5,000,000.
Everything: runs Max Stats, Unlock All Skills, all techniques, Max Mastery, Complete Story, the Rosé unlock and Full Restore in one click.

planets.name: Earth (Overworld)
planets.howToGetThere: Start here. To reach space, finish the Frieza Saga and fly above Y=500. From space, press J near Earth (it sits at about x=0, z=700 in Deep Space) to land back at your departure point.
planets.whatsThere: The normal Overworld. Protected: can't be destroyed or claimed. Faction label 'Earth's Z-Fighters'. Capsule Corp and divine visits happen here.

planets.name: Earth's Moon
planets.howToGetThere: Next to Earth in Deep Space (about x=238, z=700). Locked until the Frieza Saga is done. Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 2 moon, Saibaman colony (3 + tier enemies). Destroying it (850M integrity) causes permanent storms, no animal spawns and slow crops on Earth until wished back.

planets.name: The Sun
planets.howToGetThere: Visible from the home system (about x=-175, z=-1,100). Cannot be landed on.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 12 star, integrity 18 Qa. Strong stellar heat. Destroying it erases every unprotected world within 900 blocks.

planets.name: Mercury (Metaliana)
planets.howToGetThere: Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface. About x=-900, z=-650.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 3 terrestrial planet, volcanic terrain. Saibaman colony (derived from the mod's fixed seed). Integrity 80T.

planets.name: Venus (Vutis)
planets.howToGetThere: Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface. About x=750, z=-350.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 4 terrestrial, dune terrain. Peaceful alien settlement (conquest only). Integrity 130T.

planets.name: Mars (Mether)
planets.howToGetThere: Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface. About x=-1,400, z=850.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 4 terrestrial, crimson terrain. Frieza Force occupation (commander boss). Integrity 130T. Moons Phobos (tier 1, abandoned) and Deimos (tier 1, Saibaman).

planets.name: Jupiter (Jovius) and moons Jovius I-VII
planets.howToGetThere: Gas giant at about x=-2,400, z=900; its seven moons orbit nearby. Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Jupiter: tier 8 gas giant, observation only, integrity 2.4 Qa. Moons tier 3-6 (I-III and VI Saibaman colonies; IV, V, VII abandoned); integrity 1.2B-1.7B.

planets.name: Saturn (Sronia) and its worlds
planets.howToGetThere: Ringed planet at about x=-500, z=2,150, with Aran Ryutan, Alternaimas and Anceladus nearby. Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Saturn: tier 8 ringed planet (landable, Saibaman colony, integrity 900T). Aran Ryutan and Alternaimas: tier 5 terrestrial, Frieza-occupied (200T). Anceladus: tier 4 moon, Saibaman.

planets.name: Uranus (Ulandos) and Harut
planets.howToGetThere: Ringed planet at about x=1,650, z=2,180. Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 8 ringed planet, Saibaman colony, integrity 900T. Harut: tier 5 moon, Saibaman.

planets.name: Neptune (Nodonerrth) and Tira Triton
planets.gravity: Gas giant: no surface; Tira Triton 0.4×
planets.howToGetThere: Gas giant at about x=650, z=3,250. Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Neptune: tier 9 gas giant, observation only. Tira Triton: tier 6 moon, Saibaman colony.

planets.name: Planet Namek
planets.howToGetThere: In Deep Space at about x=2,700, z=1,050; press J nearby to land in Dragon Mine Z's Namek dimension. Flying above Y=300 there returns you to space.
planets.whatsThere: Dragon Mine Z's Namek. Protected story world: no Noea missions, can't be claimed or destroyed.

planets.name: Generated terrestrial planets
planets.howToGetThere: Found everywhere in Deep Space outside the home system. Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 2-6. Palettes Verdant, Crimson, Glacial, Astral, Warped, Dune. Saibaman, Frieza or peaceful populations, missions, climate, wildlife, alien settlements. Destroyable (50T-300T).

planets.name: Generated moons
planets.howToGetThere: Orbit generated planets. Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 1-4, 512-block wrapping surface. Lunar, ice-shell ocean, sulfur, obsidian, crystal or iron-dust geology. Saibaman colony or abandoned. No weather.

planets.name: Ringed planets
planets.howToGetThere: Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 4-8, landable. Integrity 400T-900T. Usually two moons.

planets.name: Gas giants
planets.howToGetThere: Can be visited in space only.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 5-8, observation only (no landing). Integrity 1.1-2.4 Qa. Three moons each.

planets.name: Stars
planets.howToGetThere: Visible from far away; can't be landed on.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 9-12: Star, White Dwarf, Blue Giant, Red Giant, Orange Hypergiant. Stellar heat damage. Integrity 3-18 Qa; a collapse destroys worlds within 900 blocks.

planets.name: Stained-glass and toxic planets
planets.howToGetThere: Only beyond 4,500 blocks from home (12% chance per new world). Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Stained-glass planets: cold worlds with coloured-glass ground. Toxic planets: temperate worlds with poisonous green water.

planets.name: Exotic themed worlds
planets.howToGetThere: Only beyond 4,500 blocks from home (18% chance per new world). Fly there in Deep Space (or Galaxy Atlas autopilot) and press J within 56 blocks of the surface.
planets.whatsThere: Slime planet, Honey hive world (peaceful), Cherry blossom sanctuary (peaceful), Metallic assimilation world (Frieza-occupied, hostile Metal Cooler copies), Luminous mushroom world, Coral archipelago, Storm crystal world (lightning), Volcanic caldera world and Ancient Ender ruins, each with its own surface and creatures.

planets.name: Treasure Planet
planets.howToGetThere: Hidden until you use a Treasure Locator; then shown in the Galaxy Atlas for 5 minutes.
planets.whatsThere: Tier 3 treasure-forest world, one per save, abandoned colony. Astral Vault Gate leading to a vault with 18 loot chests.

planets.name: Beerus' Planet
planets.howToGetThere: Space Pod destination unlocked by talking to Beerus or Whis during their Earth visit.
planets.whatsThere: Beerus' home planet built from a 929×250×929 map; Master Beerus and Master Whis live here. Purple sky, beds work.

planets.name: Hell (below Other World)
planets.howToGetThere: Double-tap sneak on Other World's clouds.
planets.whatsThere: Purple basins, pale groves with crimson rivers, steel ribs, thorn formations; undead mobs. Evil-aligned players must defeat 30 hostiles to leave (or use Instant Transmission).

planets.name: Server custom planets
planets.howToGetThere: Placed by the server owner via JSON; they appear in space and the Galaxy Atlas.
planets.whatsThere: Whatever the owner defines (tier, palette, kind moon/terrestrial/ringed/gas_giant/star, power multiplier).

bosses.name: Noea
bosses.where: Spawn egg (creative tab), /noea test spawn noea. Not a natural spawn.
bosses.hp: 12,000 by default (configurable 1 to 1,000,000,000 before the duel)
bosses.damage: Attack 160 (configurable 1 to 250,000,000); ki blasts 175 by default (strength x 1.09375); BP 1,950,000,000 (configurable). Armor 42, toughness 28.

bosses.where: Spawn egg, /function noeabosses:spawn_frieza, /noea test spawn frieza

bosses.notes: Teal ki: small blasts, laser, ki wave, Kienzan and Death Ball (390-tick cooldown). Movement 0.32, attack speed 5.

bosses.name: Noea (Cell Class)
bosses.where: Spawn egg, /function noeabosses:spawn_cell, /noea test spawn cell
bosses.damage: Attack 86; ki blasts 95; BP 2,100,000,000. Armor 28, toughness 14.
bosses.notes: Teal Kamehameha, Makankosappo, ki barrier, explosion and volley; meteor and rapid-kick combos.

bosses.name: Noea (Kid Buu Class)
bosses.where: Spawn egg, /function noeabosses:spawn_kid_buu, /noea test spawn kid_buu
bosses.damage: Attack 138 (2,048 after awakening); ki blasts 155 (25,000,000 after); BP 2,147,000,000 (max after). Armor 38, toughness 22.
bosses.notes: Awakens a pink Beast form at 50% health or on a killing blow, fully healing to the new maximum, then regenerates 25 HP every 10 ticks. Big Bang attack. Awakened state is saved.

bosses.name: Noea (Destroyer / Unbound)
bosses.where: Spawn egg, /function noeabosses:spawn_destroyer (also spawn_beerus). Also the 'Noea the Destroyer' raid boss look.
bosses.damage: Attack 2,048; ki blasts 50,000,000 (500,000,000 awakened); BP 2,147,483,647. Armor 30, toughness 20.
bosses.notes: Every hit counts as exactly 16 damage before awakening and 0.05 after. Awakens at 75% health. Regenerates 4 HP/s (250 HP/s awakened). Effectively unbeatable once awakened.

bosses.name: Beerus - God of Destruction (boss)
bosses.where: Beerus Boss Spawn Egg, /function noeabosses:spawn_beerus_boss or spawn_divine_cast. Not natural. (DMZ's own Beerus master is a separate NPC.)
bosses.damage: Attack 2,048; ki blasts 220,000,000; BP 2,147,483,647. Armor 50, toughness 30.
bosses.notes: Takes at most 1 damage per hit, so effectively a 250,000-hit fight. Purple god aura; very short skill cooldowns (Death Ball every 28 ticks). Very fast (movement 0.66, attack speed 16).

bosses.name: Whis - Angel Attendant (boss)
bosses.where: Whis Boss Spawn Egg, /function noeabosses:spawn_whis_boss or spawn_divine_cast. Not natural.
bosses.damage: Attack 2,048; ki blasts 750,000,000; BP 2,147,483,647. Armor 60, toughness 40.

bosses.name: Raid bosses: Legendary Broly, Super Janemba, Beerus the Destroyer, Noea the Destroyer

racesAndForms.what: Noea adds four new Saiyan form groups (God Forms, Beast Forms, Divine Rosé, Created Forms) plus Saiyan-only progression rules (Blue awakening, the Mythic Saiyan, heart disease). Numbers below are from the live config this pack generated.

forms.name: Super Saiyan God (God Forms lvl 1)
forms.unlock: Buy God Forms level 1 for 75,000 TP from a divine master (Beerus, Whis or the Grand Priest; the skill is flagged buy-from-master). Locked until the Majin Buu saga is finished (saga quest buu_saga #35). Until then the form cannot be learned, selected or used, and an active one is cancelled.
forms.notes: x4.25 STR / x4.25 SKP / x3.25 DEF / x4.25 PWR, speed x1.15, Ki drain 0.2, stackable

forms.name: Super Saiyan Blue (lvl 2)
forms.unlock: 150,000 TP and 25 mastery in SSG. With the world's 'blue requirements' switch on (default) you must also awaken it: while in SSG, select Super Saiyan and transform; that converts the transformation into Blue.
forms.notes: x5.25 STR / x5.25 SKP / x4 DEF / x5.25 PWR, speed x1.2, Ki drain 0.3

forms.name: Super Saiyan Blue Evolved (lvl 3)
forms.unlock: 300,000 TP and 25 Blue mastery. Awaken it by selecting Super Saiyan 2 while in SSG or Blue and transforming (requires Blue already awakened).
forms.notes: x6.25 STR / x6.25 SKP / x4.75 DEF / x6.25 PWR, speed x1.25, Ki drain 0.42

forms.name: Super Saiyan Rosé / Rosé Evolved (lvl 4)
forms.unlock: Wish-locked: right-click the 'God Ki Awakening' item (from Porunga's 'Awaken my God Ki!' wish) to allow buying level 4, then pay 1,000,000 TP. Rosé needs 25 SSG mastery; Rosé Evolved needs 25 Rosé mastery. If your alignment is evil (below 0) Noea automatically swaps a selected/active Blue or Blue Evolved to Rosé or Rosé Evolved.
forms.notes: Rosé uses Blue's numbers; Rosé Evolved uses Blue Evolved's numbers.

forms.name: Beast (Beast Forms)
forms.unlock: Taught by Gohan for 600,000 TP (buy from master). You must first have Ultimate (Potential Unleashed) from Gohan; Beast replaces Ultimate rather than stacking with it and does not need or grant God Ki. Locked until the Majin Buu saga is finished (saga quest buu_saga #35). Until then the form cannot be learned, selected or used, and an active one is cancelled.
forms.notes: x7.5 STR / x7.5 SKP / x5.5 DEF / x7.5 PWR, speed x1.3, Ki drain 0.38. Older saves that had Beast inside God Forms are migrated to the new group ('Beast (Legacy)' label).

forms.name: Super Saiyan Rosé (Divine Rosé group)
forms.unlock: Only for a Demon/Glind mind living in a Saiyan body (Super Shenron body wish, Goku Black style). It unlocks automatically once your Super Saiyan skill reaches the configured level (wishes.roseSuperSaiyanLevel, default 1) and the Buu saga is done. God and Blue are blocked for that character.
forms.notes: x5.25 STR / x5.25 SKP / x4 DEF / x5.25 PWR, requires Super Saiyan as prerequisite

forms.name: Created Form I / II
forms.unlock: Designed and bought at the Capsule Corp Form Designer (see the custom-forms feature).
forms.notes: Available to every race.

fusion.how: Noea takes over Dragon Mine Z's fusion system and adds new ways to fuse. (1) Player with player: use DMZ's fusion (Metamoru dance, Potara earrings, or the Fusion Arm Band); Noea validates it and runs the whole timed session. (2) With a story master: after 5 sparring wins against that master, their dialogue offers Dance, Potara or Arm Band fusion. (3) At Capsule Corp: Fusion Expert Bulma (or Bulma's Fusion Machine block) lets you fuse with any unlocked Story Fighter or any living mob, or start a solo 'Five-way Ultra' fusion with four Story Fighters. (4) Force Potara: wear a Right Potara in the head slot, hold the matching Left Potara, and press the Flow State modifier (Left Alt) plus the Senzu Pouch key (Y) to throw it at a player or mob within 24 blocks. While fused, U powers up through fusion forms (sneak+U powers down), G uses the fusion's special move, and fused players can rename the fusion.
rules: Methods and default length: Dance 15 min (18,000 ticks, both fighters must be the same race), Potara 30 min (36,000 ticks; DMZ's beetle fusion also 30 min), Arm Band 15 min (both must wear a band), Five-way 15 min.
After a timed fusion ends there is a 15-minute cooldown (18,000 ticks). A warning appears with 60 seconds left, and safe unfusing is allowed from then.
Potara fusions by Demon/Glind (and Kai/Shin races) are permanent. Only the dragon wish 'Undo a permanent Potara fusion' (Shenron or Porunga) or an admin can split them.
Two-player power: Dance and Arm Band fusions multiply power by 1.25 to 2.0, and Potara by 1.75 to 2.5. The closer the two fighters' power, the higher the multiplier.
Fusions with masters or Fusion Expert partners deal x1.35 damage and take x0.85 damage. Each fusion power-up stage adds x1.35 damage. Goku, Vegeta, Gohan and Trunks can power up to fusion form 2.
Transforming while fused costs fusion time: Super Saiyan 1 min, SSJ2/SSJ3 3 min, God 2 min, Blue or a race's top form 5 min. Time spent this way is not given back when you return to base.

Fusion special move (G): costs 12% of max Ki, 4-second cooldown, 24-block range, deals 65% of your Ki damage. The effect depends on the partner: impact, binding, recovery or drain. Examples: Goku 'Turtle School Burst', Vegeta 'Royal Breaker', Frieza 'Emperor Drain', Whis 'Angel's Renewal'. There are 25 master recipes in all.

Five-way Ultra (players): the DMZ party must have exactly 5 online members within 8 blocks of the host, all wearing Fusion Arm Bands and all toggled to Fusion in the X menu and powering up. The host controls the fusion. Stats become 5x the sum of everyone's stats (capped at 2,000,000,000) and battle power 5x the sum. Taking off any band starts a safe split.

Five-way Ultra (solo): at Fusion Expert Bulma, pick exactly four unlocked Story Fighters (no mobs) and wear one Arm Band; Bulma supplies the other four. Holding G for 3 seconds fires the Ultra Rainbow Final Explosion once per fusion, which uses up some of the remaining fusion time.

Fusion Arm Band: worn in the Curios 'Fusion Band' body slot. Crafting: 7 gold ingots around 1 lapis lazuli. Bulma can also build one for 5 iron ingots, 1 diamond and 1 glass. Arm Band fusions with masters also use up a spare band from your inventory.
Potara with a master needs one DMZ Pothala earring worn and its matching earring carried; both are used up.
Arm Band requests between players time out after 15 seconds (300 ticks); declining starts a 10-second cooldown.
Fused characters can use their partner race's form groups, for example a Saiyan partner adds Super Saiyan up to level 8, Legendary 3 and God Forms 4.
Mob fusion uses per-mob attachment presets for 33 vanilla mobs (hair, arm band and Potara placement) and has an in-game attachment editor.
Testing/recovery commands: /noea test fusion …, /noea recovery fusion <player>.

gamma.what: The Gamma Protocol turns a Human Android or a Bio-Android into a Gamma-style android (like Gamma 1/2 from Super Hero). It adds three forms, Gamma, Gamma 120% and Gamma 150%, to the Android Forms group, and comes with the Gamma Appearance Lab, an editor for the Gamma suit's look.

Gamma is then unlocked and selected, your original race is kept, and you get a Gamma Customizer (it is given back if lost). 3) Open the editor by right-clicking the Gamma Customizer or pressing the 'Open Gamma Appearance Lab' key (default H, which clashes with DMZ's H). Options: Gamma origin (Human or Bio-Android), chest number (0-9 or none), 16-colour palettes for body, gloves, belt, helmet, cape and number, helmet fins (none, one or two), show/hide armour, and a live front/back preview with Save, Cancel and Reset. 4) Gamma 150% is an overdrive with a 5-minute safety limit. If you stay in it the full 5 minutes you explode and die; powering down earlier starts a 7-minute cooldown. The cape is a visual item (gamma_cape_visual).

keybinds.name: Flow State Modifier
keybinds.what: Hold + left-click with an empty hand to start Flow State on the aimed target. Also the modifier for throwing a Senzu Bean (Alt + Y) or force-throwing a Potara. Same default as DMZ's Second Function key (Alt + 1-4 techniques, Alt + G descend, Alt + C lower release).

keybinds.name: Super Dash Attack
keybinds.what: Double-tap (0.05-0.65 s) to Super Dash at the aimed target; hold W, A, D or S for arc or blind-side dashes. In Noea Styled Combat the same double-tap is Combat Pursuit (hold S for rear). Shares R with DMZ's dash key on purpose (a single tap still dashes).

keybinds.name: Combo Ender (optional; same as right-click)
keybinds.what: Heavy/ender strike in Noea Styled Combat; hold to charge. Unbound in the live instance, and the pack's default key list puts vanilla swap-offhand on O.

keybinds.name: Grab / Release (Experimental)
keybinds.what: Grab the target in reach, release a held target, or (as the victim) break out. Needs /noea experimental grab on. Clashes with DMZ's Lock On (Z).

keybinds.name: Cycle Lock-On Target
keybinds.what: Switches DMZ lock-on to the next target in a 44-degree cone; range 15 + 5 per Ki Sense level (+25 for upgraded androids). Needs Ki Sense.

keybinds.name: Sonic Break (double press)
keybinds.what: Double-press within 7 ticks while flying (Fly 8+) to enter Sonic Break; again (max Fly level) for Double Break. Same key as vanilla sprint.

keybinds.name: Scan / Track
keybinds.what: Opens the Universe Sense scan screen to choose a signature to track. Also reachable from Ki Actions in DMZ's utility menu (X). DMZ's Ki Sense key (F4) cycles sense display modes.

keybinds.name: Toggle Aura
keybinds.what: Toggles DMZ's permanent aura (needs Ki Control). Same default as DMZ's Stats Menu (V), so both fire unless one is rebound.

keybinds.name: Use Senzu Pouch
keybinds.what: Eat a bean from the pouch; Left Alt + Y throws one to an ally; Alt + Y while holding a left Potara earring force-throws it. The pack's default key list moves voice-chat groups to Y, which clashes.

keybinds.name: Evil Eye / Fusion Transform (Sneak: Power Down)
keybinds.what: Demon Evil Eye transform up (sneak + U powers down); while fused it transforms the fusion instead; while holding a 175% Spirit Bomb as a Saiyan it absorbs it (Spirit Infusion). The pack's default key list moves the voice-chat menu to U, which clashes.

keybinds.name: Fusion Ability
keybinds.what: Uses the active fusion's signature technique; for the five-way Ultra fusion, hold for 60 ticks (3 s). Clashes with DMZ's Action key (G).

keybinds.name: Open Gamma Appearance Lab
keybinds.what: Opens the Gamma customizer (the server checks eligibility). Clashes with DMZ's Space Pod menu (H).

keybinds.name: Open God of Destruction Menu
keybinds.what: Opens the Destroyer path / role menu. (DMZ's rhythm-minigame 'up' key is also K, but only inside the minigame screen.)

keybinds.name: Galaxy Atlas
keybinds.what: Opens the galaxy map in dimensions that support it.

keybinds.name: Travel to Nearby Planet
keybinds.what: In Deep Space, lands on the nearest planet or moon you are looking at.

keybinds.name: Toggle Pro Cam (Autopilot)
keybinds.what: While riding a Space Pod in Deep Space, toggles the cinematic autopilot camera. An old F6 default is migrated to P once.

keybinds.name: Majin Absorption Goo
keybinds.what: Majin only: throw absorption goo / absorb the target. (JourneyMap's waypoint key is also B in this pack.)

keybinds.name: Combat Pursuit (double tap; Back: rear)
keybinds.what: Label only; there is no separate key mapping, pursuit uses the Super Dash key.

changesToDmz: TRAINING / TP: Kill rewards are capped. DMZ's kill TP uses the victim's max health; Noea substitutes min(health, 8 x sqrt(health), 2048), using the victim's health before Realistic Mode scaling. Small mobs (64 HP or less) are unaffected; bosses give far less kill TP.
TRAINING / TP: DMZ's passive TP tick is routed through a Noea hook with the same amount (no numeric change).

TRAINING / TP: Realistic Mode (off by default) multiplies every TP gain (x3 with story balance, Frost Demons x4.5 total; legacy x0.5), changes enemy health and damage, rewrites form multipliers in memory, and replaces the TP/attribute rewards of key saga quests with fixed milestone payouts (150k to 2.4M TP).
TRAINING / TP: DMZ form-skill TP prices go through Realistic pricing when Realistic Mode is on (tiered story prices, or x10 in legacy mode).
GRAVITY / WEIGHTS: Noea does not touch DMZ's gravity-chamber or weighted-clothing TP multipliers or training.json; they behave as in base DMZ. /noea tpdebug only reports them.

GRAVITY: On generated moon surfaces Noea lowers real physical gravity with the Forge entity-gravity attribute (Earth's Moon 0.35x, other moons 0.4x) and scales fall damage the same way; it is removed on death or logout, and destroyed moons go back to normal.
GRAVITY: Sonic Break speed is multiplied by DMZ's gravity flight factor and is blocked when DMZ gravity hard-stops flight.

SKILLS (skills.json patched; backup skills.json.pre_noea_085c_backup): adds superdash (50,000 / 150,000 TP), flowstate (100,000), stepvanish (50,000, Goku only), candy_beam (cost raised from 5,000 to 150,000; Majin and Human; moved from Buu to Mr. Popo), extends godkienhancement and createdforms to Sphinxian and Alien (Whis and Beerus offer God Ki enhancement), and adds form skills mimicforms, piccolobiodata, demonforms (150k / 450k / 1.2M), demigraforms (300k / 850k / 2M), divinerose, sphinxianforms (175k / 525k / 1.35M), alienforms (175k / 525k / 1.35M), friezabiodata (350k / 1.5M) and pureprogress (1M / 1.5M). Goku, Vegeta, Gohan, Piccolo, Krillin, Trunks, Yamcha and Roshi now also teach Super Dash and Flow State.
SKILLS: learned skill levels are no longer lowered when DMZ refreshes or shrinks a skill's max level on load.

SKILLS / TECHNIQUES: upgrades earned on DMZ predefined ki techniques are kept when DMZ reloads the template; invalid technique create / import / purchase requests are rejected before any cost is taken; technique rewards cannot be claimed twice.

RACE CONFIGS (races/*/character.json; backups such as *.pre_noea_095a81623_created_form_ownership_backup): every race gets a 'createdforms' entry bought from a master (price -1 = special); Saiyan God forms become buyable from a master at 75k / 150k / 300k / 1M TP and Beast forms at 600k; Human gains majinandroidforms, Namekian pureprogress (1M / 1.5M), Bio-Android androidforms and piccolobiodata (400k / 1.75M), Majin mimicforms (240k / 900k). Noea also installs the Demon, Sphinxian and Alien race folders.

FORM CONFIGS: Noea installs missing form files from its built-in overlay (frost god forms, Frieza bio data, God Ki enhancement, Ultra Ego, Ultra Instinct, android/Gamma forms, Cell Max, Piccolo bio data, Majin Android, Majin mimicry, Orange Piccolo progress, Beast, God forms, Divine Rose, created forms for 9 races) and then runs one-time migrations, each leaving a backup or a '.noea_*_v1' stamp so later admin edits are kept.

FORM CONFIGS (migrations seen in this instance): Ultimate (Gohan) becomes stackable (DMZ made it incompatible with itself); Golden/Black Frieza and Corrupted Giant gain mastery training rates where DMZ had 0 (Golden 0.04 per hit dealt and received, 0.006 per 5 s; Black 0.03 / 0.03 / 0.004; Corrupted Giant 0.04 / 0.04 / 0.006); Ultra Instinct Sign/Mastered and Super Saiyan Blue lose DMZ's lightning (Noea draws its own); Rose eye colours matched; Beast stacking adjusted; Orange Piccolo upkeep and Majin Android stacking presets reviewed.

CONFIG SYNC: Noea installs its forms before DMZ's first config scan, moves Alien to the end of the race list, and only lets DMZ's server-config sync overwrite configs on the logical client (so singleplayer files are not clobbered).

CLIENT SETTINGS (general-user.json; backup general-user.json.pre_noea_presentation_backup): a one-time 'creator presentation' preset changes untouched DMZ defaults: firstPersonAnimated true to false, techniqueHotbarRightSide false to true, alwaysVisibleHudValues false to true, xenoverseHudScale 1.0 to 0.55, overShoulderUp 0.35 to 0.01, overShoulderSide 1.45 to 1.5; it also sets Minecraft GUI scale from auto to 4 and FOV from 70 to 75. Set creatorPresentationPreset.enabled = false before first launch to skip it. (Other differences in the live file, such as aura 3D style and tutorials seen, are the player's own.)
TECHNIQUES.JSON: not changed by Noea (the pack ships its own crater settings).
COMBAT: when Noea Styled Combat owns a melee swing, DMZ's own melee request is cancelled; a DMZ melee attack also stops Sonic Break.
COMBAT: Noea combat moves that already paid stamina skip DMZ's per-hit stamina drain (no double charge).
COMBAT: DMZ saga NPCs and mobs stunned by Noea combat share one stun state (no spinning, AI paused).
COMBAT: for players opted into styled combat, mob melee hits get a short wind-up so they can be read and dodged.
COMBAT: DMZ's combat-flight passive descent (a -0.05 per tick sink) is removed, so you hover in place in combat flight.

COMBAT: battle power: upgraded androids show a finite BP instead of DMZ's special value; fusion BP overrides apply; Evil Eye, Hakai, Ultra Instinct and created-form multipliers plus permanent absorption power are added server-side.
COMBAT: DMZ shadow-dummy training hits are capped at 15% of max health and end at 5% health; Noea's immortality wish and story-encounter damage rules hook into final damage.

COMBAT: DMZ lock-on (Z) uses Noea's target picker and aims correctly at enlarged bodies; DMZ's built-in Ki Sense alert ping is turned off in favour of Universe Sense; Noea adds Step Vanish, Universe Effects and two Universe Sense entries to DMZ's Ki Actions radial.
POWER-UP: transforming or snapping to full release above 2.1M BP now emits a 6-block push shockwave (no damage).
WISHES: DMZ dragon wishes get per-player cooldowns (Shenron 600 s, Porunga 1200 s, Super Shenron 300 s); new Noea wishes are added to old wish lists once (backups kept).

RAIDS / TOURNAMENTS / WORLD BOSS: entering a DMZ raid, tournament or world-boss fight is refused while you are in a Noea raid, bracket, Tournament of Power, sparring match, Flow State or grab (and the other way round). Noea raid types are appended to DMZ's raid list but must be started from /noearaid. Raid-boss damage bypasses DMZ's damage and armour pipeline. DMZ's Janemba world boss, Otherworld tournament grounds and Hell stampede get save/restart recovery and safer building.
QUESTS: DMZ's quest upgrader and registry are wrapped so saved quests from earlier Noea versions migrate safely (finish the old contract before the new version starts).

SAIYANS: Noea runs its own birth rolls for Saiyans instead of DMZ's mutant lottery (1% mutant, 0.05% one-per-save mythic Saiyan, 0.1% heart disease). Blue and Rose need an 'awakening' earned by going from SSG into SSJ (God Forms skill 2+); Blue Evolved and Rose Evolved by going from SSG or Blue into SSJ2 (God Forms 3+). Buying Rose is gated; Beast is selectable once learned.
FORMS: extra gates and handling for Bio-Android Gamma forms, divine Saiyan forms, post-Buu forms, Majin / absorbed / created form data and fusion lineage when selecting forms.

UI: DMZ's utility menu (X) gains a Senzu Pouch slot and a Majin Absorb / Fusion status slot; DMZ NPC dialogue gains a Noea services panel (Alt + N); Character Stats shows fusion names and finite android BP; Candy Beam is only offered by Popo to eligible races; Ultra Ego is only offered once the Destroyer questline is complete.

UI: vanilla heart rendering is skipped when max health plus absorption exceeds 200 (avoids huge heart rows); the title screen gets Noea's panorama and logo; DMZ race selection defaults change (Demon defaults to a female body with pink aura; tail default follows race config; secret races unlock with a creator code).

SPACE / TRAVEL: Beerus' planet is added as a DMZ Space Pod destination once unlocked; Space Pod autopilot and server-side piloting; a destroyed vehicle (pod) is returned to whoever broke it; clouds are hidden in space; destroyed moons are removed from the sky; beds on planets work as respawn points (also for Enma revival).

HELL / OTHERWORLD: temporary basic DMZ flight below Other World's clouds; Instant Transmission can exit Hell; undead do not burn in Hell; Hell scenery is protected; Otherworld heightmaps, duplicate NPCs and arrival points are repaired.
COMPAT: client mixins for Embeddium, Oculus/Iris shaders, Essential mod previews and Complementary shader lighting.

HELL / OTHERWORLD: Replaces DMZ's Other World dimension type: build height 448 → 896 blocks (bottom moved from Y=-64 to Y=-512), ambient light 0.35 → 0.0 and a Noea sky effect, to make room for Hell below the clouds. Older worlds get DMZ's native Other World landmarks re-installed carefully and their heightmaps repaired.

SPACE / TRAVEL: Patches DMZ's Space Pod destination list: the 'Beerus' destination (which DMZ ships as never-unlockable) now unlocks with Noea's Beerus-planet tag and arrives at about 31, 69, 30; a new always-available 'Deep Space' destination is inserted after the Time Chamber.
SPACE / TRAVEL: Provides the dmzsuper:space, dmzsuper:planet_surface and dmzsuper:beerus_planet dimensions that DMZ references (DMZ already prices Instant Transmission to Beerus' planet).
SPACE / TRAVEL: Flying above Y=500 in the Overworld after the Frieza Saga takes you to Deep Space instead of just flying higher.
SPACE / TRAVEL: Gating uses DMZ quest progress: Frieza Saga quest 16 for space flight (Buu Saga quest 35 is used elsewhere as 'story complete').
SPACE / TRAVEL: Right-clicking air with DMZ's Saiyan Space Pod in Deep Space deploys and boards it.

SPACE / TP: Heavy DMZ ki techniques (waves, beams, giant balls, explosions, big medium balls) can destroy celestial bodies in space and give TP/evil alignment; Hakai projectiles need Destroyer authorisation.
SPACE / TP: Planet missions and destruction pay out DMZ training points and change DMZ alignment.

SPACE / TP: Deep Space enemies are real DMZ saga entities (Saibamen, Frieza soldiers, Ginyu Force, Frieza, Z-Fighters, Metal Cooler) with Noea-assigned battle power, AI tier and ki damage; Namek warriors on generated worlds are replaced by Noea's Alien Inhabitants.

MASTERS / NPCS: DMZ master skill offerings are rewritten (re-applied every second on clients and at server start): Ultra Ego is removed from every master; Beerus gets a fixed list (flight, ki basics, Potential Unlock, God Forms, Ultra Ego only after the Destroyer questline, Super God Fist, Big Bang, Death Beam, Supernova, Final Explosion, Ki Barrage, Deadly Dance, Hakai...); Whis gets his own list (adds Ki Infusion, God Ki Enhancement, Ultra Instinct, Instant Transmission, Soul Punisher, Kamehameha, Meteor...); Gohan also teaches Beast Forms; a new 'grand_priest' master offers every skill except Candy Beam and ritual-only 'ultimate' skills.
MASTERS / NPCS: DMZ's Beerus and Whis masters are reused as 'divine visitors' on Earth; while visiting, right-clicking them unlocks Beerus's Planet instead of opening their normal dialogue.
MASTERS / NPCS: A 'Noea Services' panel (Spar, Fusion Dance/Potara/Arm Band, Senzu Pouch purchase/upgrade, Visit the Zenos, Destroyer Path, Return to Earth) is added to DMZ NPC dialogue for masters.
SAGA NPCS: DMZ saga NPCs spawned outside quests get fixed canonical stats from DMZ 2.1.2 quest values; /noea saga_repair can restore saga NPCs whose stats were overwritten by an older Noea build.
SAGA NPCS: Bracket, spar and spectated fighters are sent to clients more often (entity update interval at most 2 ticks) for smoother fights.

RAIDS / TOURNAMENTS / WORLD BOSS: DMZ raid and tournament sign-ups are blocked when a party member is busy with a Noea activity (fusion, Tournament of Power, spar, etc.); an earned DMZ raid omen is held until the party is free instead of expiring (milk or effect removal still cancels it).

RAIDS / TOURNAMENTS / WORLD BOSS: DMZ's Otherworld tournament grounds: the build is paced (chunk tickets released, paused/resumed), the build area is recorded so Noea can protect it, and the return teleport to Grand Kai checks for obstructed landing platforms instead of dropping players into blocks.
RAIDS / TOURNAMENTS / WORLD BOSS: DMZ's Janemba fight is given a dedicated lower-Hell arena (radius 22) in Noea's Hell, with restart-safe recovery of an in-progress Janemba encounter.
RAIDS / TOURNAMENTS / WORLD BOSS: No Noea changes were found in the live config/dragonminez/raids/*.json or tournaments/*.json files; Noea's raid definitions live only in memory.

RACES: Adds three races (alien, demon, sphinxian) by writing their character/stats/form files into config/dragonminez/races and hooking DMZ's race loader. Alien is listed last, and Alien and Demon/Glind are hidden until the secret code is entered.
FORMS: Ultra Ego is cut to a single 'mastered' stage in Noea's config; Ultra Instinct gets a stamina-based damage bonus and the True UI dodge upgrade.
FUSION: Takes over DMZ's native fusion (Metamoru/Pothala/Beetle): Noea runs the lifecycle and timers, makes Demon/Glind Potara permanent, and adds same-race checks for Dance.
ABSORPTION: Noea's Majin absorption works alongside DMZ's native Majin absorption, and permanently adds absorbed melee and Ki damage to DMZ's stat getters.
POWER RELEASE: Max power release can be raised from 115% to 150% through a Super Shenron wish.

Earth conquest: messages say Earth 'can be conquered after the story', and an 'Earth's Champion' final battle and Earth Z-Fighter population exist in code, but Earth is on the protected list, so missions there are refused ('This story world cannot be claimed').
The lang entry 'Planet Defender - BP %s' is a leftover; the current enemies use roles (minion, boss, defender, claim defender) and other labels.
The old separate treasure_vault dimension remains only so players inside it can be moved out; the vault now lives under the Treasure Planet.
Custom planet/form JSON definitions are labelled a 'v0.95 foundation' feature with strict validation; this instance's validation report lists 0 custom planets and 0 custom forms.
Deep Space commands (/noeaspace travel, return, summon_shenron, spawn_planet, spawn_moon) are classed as testing commands (operator level 2).

World Tournament natural placement is disabled in this build (the chunk-load hook is empty; rarity 1,500 and minimum distance 1,000 constants are unused), so the court only exists if an operator builds it.
Environmental (block-breaking) Hakai is not implemented: the config note says the 'alpha.8 core' does nothing when allowEnvironmentalHakai is false, and no block-damage path was found.
The Noea Destroyer and Whis/Beerus boss entities are tuned to be practically unkillable (fixed tiny damage per hit plus heavy regeneration) and have no loot; they read as showcase/test bosses.
Several admin commands keep a historical name (/noea v095 ...) from the v0.95 'foundation' work.
The World Tournament court, the Noea boss family and the hostile Beerus/Whis bosses can only be reached through spawn eggs, datapack functions or /noea test commands; none spawn naturally.
No TP or item reward is coded for winning a bracket or the Tournament of Power (victory screen only).
Bulma's Fusion Machine block has no crafting recipe or natural placement in the bundled data (unsure how it is meant to be obtained).
The Immortality Wish item has no current source in the bundled wish lists (probably a leftover or dev item).
The dev tool items in the creative tab have no permission check of their own, and any nearby player can open the main Noea boss's stat-config screen before his duel (no operator check).
Evil Third Eye is labelled 'W.I.P' in its item and wish names.
'Legacy Potara (Unused)' item is registered but does nothing.
Namekian 'Golden Namekian' and 'Awakened Golden Giant' have names in the language file, but no form config was found.

The language file has Shenron/Porunga wish texts (immortality, waifu, 'Ultimate Development Power', 'Divine Training Kit', Shenron 5M TP, Shenron God Ki/Gamma/Cell Max) that are not in the bundled wish lists. They are probably from older versions.
The 'Switch Fusion Contributor' key has a name in the language file, but no key mapping was found.
Spirit Bomb absorption seems to be visual only (no stat change found).
The Form Designer has an unused-looking 'Form Forge is still calibrating' line, and a Super Dragon Ball message mentions a 'future wish registry'.
Some story fighters are refused by the Fusion Expert because 'Fusion anatomy is not yet supported for this fighter'.
Noea Styled Combat (combos, Step Vanish, Combat Pursuit) is opt-in and labelled experimental; its config block is named 'experimentalExchange' and described as prototype combat defaults.
Grabs are labelled '(Experimental)' and are off by default per character.
/noea combatpractice unlock is a temporary testing override for Step Vanish and Super Dash; /noea test unlock_combat grants Flow State 1 and Super Dash 2 for QA.
Super Dash has a 'removed follow-up' mode that is disabled in this build.
'Combat Pursuit' has its own key label but reuses the Super Dash key (R).
A grab 'strike' action exists on the server but no client input sends it (only throw, place and release are reachable).
Realistic Mode keys storyEnemyHealthMultiplier (6.0) and storyEnemyDamageMultiplier (1.5) look unused by the per-saga scaling path (unsure).
